prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Glazed Orange Scones Ingredients: 1/3 cup Granulated Sugar 2 medium oranges, zested 2 cup all purpose flour 1 tsp baking powder 1/4 tsp baking soda 1/2 tsp salt 8 tbsp unsalted butter, frozen 1/2 cup Sour Cream 3 tbsp unsalted butter melted 1 cup confectioners sugar; sifted 1/2 tsp vanilla extract 2 tbsp freshly squeezed Orange juice._SEP_Adjust your oven rack to lower-middle position and preheat oven to 400F._SEP_Line a baking sheet with parchment paper._SEP_In a large bowl, combine sugar and Orange zest; mixing with your fingertips until the sugar is moistened and fragrant._SEP_In a separate bowl whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt._SEP_Then add this to the moistened sugar and mix until combined._SEP_Grate frozen butter into flour mixture on the large holes of a box greater; use your fingers to work in the butter until the mixture resembles coarse meal._SEP_In a small bowl, whisk the sour cream and egg until smooth._SEP_Using a fork, stir in sour cream mixture into flour mixture until large dough clumps form._SEP_Use your hands to press dough against the bowl into a ball.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Cheesy Chicken and Rice Bake Ingredients: 1 (10 3/4 ounce) can Campbell's Cream of Chicken Soup 1 13 cups water 34 cup uncooked white rice 12 teaspoon onion powder 14 teaspoon ground black pepper 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese._SEP_Mix soup, water, rice, onion powder and black pepper in 2 quart shallow baking dish._SEP_Top with chicken._SEP_Sprinkle chicken with additional pepper._SEP_Cover and bake at 375* for 45 mins or until chicken is no longer pink and rice is done._SEP_Top with cheese._SEP_Optional: Stir 2 cups of fresh, canned, or frozen vegetables into soup mixture before topping with chicken._SEP_For a Mexican twist: Omit onion powder and pepper._SEP_Add 1 teaspoons chili powder to soup mixture._SEP_Substitute mexican cheese blend for the cheddar.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Spicy West Indies Fish Ingredients: 4 lbs filleted red snapper 1 12 cups freshly squeezed lime juice 1 tablespoon curry powder 1 tablespoon ground cumin 1 tablespoon paprika 1 tablespoon allspice 1 tablespoon powdered ginger 1 tablespoon salt 1 tablespoon fresh ground black pepper 1 12 tablespoons cayenne pepper virgin olive oil or cooking spray._SEP_Soak the fish in lime juice for 30 minutes in a glass pan or non-corrosive dish._SEP_Remove the fish, reserving the juice._SEP_Combine the curry powder, cumin, paprika, allspice, ginger, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper in a small bowl and stir until well blended._SEP_Place each fish fillet on an individual sheet of aluminum foil._SEP_Coat each fillet with the spice mixture._SEP_Sprinkle a tablespoon of the lime juice over each piece of fish._SEP_Wrap each fillet tightly in the foil.
gen_body: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat._SEP_Brush the grill grates with olive oil or cooking spray to prevent the fish from sticking._SEP_Place the wrapped fish fillets on the grill and cook for approximately 10-12 minutes, or until the fish is fully cooked and flakes easily with a fork._SEP_Carefully remove the fish from the grill using tongs._SEP_Serve immediately, with a squeeze of fresh lime juice and a garnish of chopped fresh cilantro or parsley._SEP_This spicy West Indies Fish is perfect for a summer BBQ or a weeknight dinner._SEP_The lime juice adds a bright, citrusy flavor that complements the heat from the spices, while the fish stays moist and tender inside its foil packet._SEP_If you don't have access to red snapper, you can substitute any firm white fish, such as cod or halibut._SEP_If you prefer a milder flavor, you can reduce the amount of cayenne pepper in the spice mixture._SEP_Leftovers can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days._SEP_Reheat in a 350 degree oven until heated through, or enjoy cold as a tasty addition to a salad or sandwich.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Sancocho de Gallina Ingredients: 12 to 14 cups water 1 hen or large chicken, about 4 pounds, cut into 10 to 12 pieces 2 stalks scallion, whole 1/2 white onion 2 sprigs of cilantro 1/4 cup olive oil 1 bunch scallions, about 8 chopped 1 tomato, finely chopped 1/2 onion, finely chopped 4 cloves garlic, finely chopped 1/4 cup finely chopped cilantro 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 14 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper 5 strands saffron 2 green plantains, broken by hand into pieces 2 yucca (cassava) peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces 4 red potatoes, cut into 2-inch pieces 2 ears of corn, kernels removed, optional 1/4 cup chopped cilantro leaves, plus more for garnish 3 chicken-flavored bouillon cubes Salt and freshly ground black pepper Avocado slices._SEP_Put the chicken or hen with the whole scallions, onion and cilantro in a large pot with the water._SEP_Cover and cook over high heat until boiling then reduce to low and simmer until cooked through and tender, 20 to 25 minutes for chicken or 45 minutes if using a hen._SEP_Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside._SEP_Remove whole scallions and onion and discard._SEP_Reserve the stock.
gen_body: In the same pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat._SEP_Add the chopped scallions, tomato, onion, garlic and cilantro._SEP_Cook until the vegetables are soft, about 8 minutes._SEP_Add the cumin, salt, pepper and saffron and stir to combine._SEP_Add the plantains, yucca, potatoes and corn (if using) to the pot._SEP_Pour in the reserved stock, add the bouillon cubes and bring to a boil._SEP_Reduce heat to low and let simmer until the vegetables are tender, about 30 to 40 minutes._SEP_While the vegetables are cooking, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces and add them back into the pot._SEP_Stir in the chopped cilantro and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper if needed._SEP_Serve the sancocho de gallina hot with avocado slices and more chopped cilantro for garnish._SEP_Enjoy!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Cream Cheese and Passionfruit Frosting Ingredients: 250 g softened cream cheese 14 cup butter 1 teaspoon vanilla 3 cups icing sugar (confectioners sugar) 14 passion fruit pulp._SEP_Combine cream cheese, butter and vanilla in a small bowl._SEP_Using an electric mixer, beat until smooth.
gen_body: Gradually add icing sugar and beat until mixture is fluffy and creamy._SEP_**Tip: Sift your icing sugar to avoid lumps!_SEP_** Once your frosting is ready, it's time to add the passionfruit pulp._SEP_Take 2-3 ripe passionfruits and cut them in half._SEP_Scoop out the pulp with a spoon and place it in a separate bowl._SEP_Using a fork, mash the pulp until it's smooth and all the seeds are separated._SEP_Add the passionfruit pulp to your frosting mixture and beat on low until it's fully incorporated._SEP_Taste to check if the passionfruit flavour is strong enough for your liking._SEP_If not, you can add more pulp and adjust according to your taste preference._SEP_To ensure the frosting is smooth and lump-free, run the mixture through a sieve to remove any seeds or pulp bits._SEP_Transfer the frosting into a piping bag fitted with your favourite nozzle._SEP_You can also use an offset spatula to spread the frosting on cakes or cupcakes._SEP_This cream cheese and passionfruit frosting pairs perfectly with citrusy desserts like lemon or orange cakes._SEP_It also works well with chocolate cupcakes, adding a tart contrast to the sweet and indulgent cake._SEP_If you have leftover frosting, store it in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week._SEP_Bring it to room temperature before using it again, to ensure it spreads easily and smoothly._SEP_Experiment with other fruits to create unique and delicious frosting flavours._SEP_Try mango, kiwi, or raspberry for a fruity twist on classic cream cheese frosting._SEP_Don't forget to decorate with extra passion fruit pulp and fresh berries for a beautiful and colourful dessert._SEP_Now you know how to make cream cheese and passionfruit frosting it's time to get baking and enjoy this lip-smackingly good frosting on your favourite cakes, cupcakes, and desserts!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Straight-Up Roast Beef Ingredients: One 2 1/2 to 3 1/2-pound top round roast, tied at 1 1/2 inch intervals (see Notes) Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 1 tablespoon peanut oil or grapeseed oil 1/2 cup heavy cream 1/3 cup creme fraiche or sour cream 1/2 cup prepared horseradish, drained 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard Squeeze of fresh lemon juice Kosher salt and freshly ground white pepper._SEP_To Make the Roast:_SEP_Season the Beef: If seasoning in advance, sprinkle 1 1/2 teaspoons salt and 3/4 teaspoon black pepper over the entire surface and refrigerate, uncovered or loosely covered, for 24 to 28 hours._SEP_Heat the Oven: Position a rack near the center of the oven and heat to 250 degrees (225 degrees convection)._SEP_Fit a shallow roasting pan, baking dish, or heavy-duty baking sheet with a flat roasting rack, if you have one._SEP_You can also roast the meat directly on the pan._SEP_Brown the Meat: Pat dry the entire surface of the meat._SEP_If you didnt season in advance, season it now all over with salt and pepper._SEP_Heat a large heavy skillet over medium-high heat (cast iron works nicely)._SEP_When the skillet is hot, add the oil, let it heat for several seconds, and place the meat in the pan.
gen_body: Sear the meat until it is well browned on all sides, turning it with tongs as needed._SEP_This should take 10 to 12 minutes total._SEP_Roast the Meat: Transfer the roast to the prepared roasting pan or baking dish._SEP_Insert a meat thermometer into the thickest part of the roast, making sure it does not touch bone or the roasting pan._SEP_Roast the beef until the thermometer reads 120 to 125 degrees for rare, 130 to 135 degrees for medium-rare, or 140 to 145 degrees for medium, about 2 to 2 1/2 hours._SEP_Let the Meat Rest: Remove the roast from the oven and tent with foil._SEP_Let it rest for at least 20 minutes (or up to 40 minutes) before carving._SEP_Make the Horseradish Sauce: While the roast rests, combine the cream, creme fraiche or sour cream, horseradish, mustard, a squeeze of lemon juice, and a pinch of salt and white pepper in a small bowl._SEP_Whisk until smooth._SEP_Serve: Slice the beef thinly and serve with the horseradish sauce._SEP_Enjoy!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Grandma's Holiday Fruit Salad Ingredients: 1 cup red apple, cored and diced 1 cup green apple, cored and diced 1 cup pineapple chunk (if canned then drain) 12 cup celery, diced 12 cup carrot, grated 13 cup raisins 13 cup dried cranberries 13 cup dried apricot, chopped in to smaller pieces 1 cup yogurt (non fat, low fat or regular) or 1 cup mayonnaise (non fat, low fat or regular) 12 cup dry white wine (I use the pineapple juice from the canned pineapple) 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves, chopped (1 tsp dried) 1 cup pecans, chopped 1 cup cheddar cheese, grated._SEP_Place the fruits, vegetables and dried fruit in a._SEP_salad bowl._SEP_Mix together the mayonnaise, wine, and mint leaves._SEP_Pour over the vegetables and toss lightly._SEP_Add the pecans and cheese, lightly toss._SEP_Serve a scoop of this salad on a plate with a lettuce leaf._SEP_underneath as a garnish.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Monkeyboy Banana Chocolate Cake Ingredients: 14 cup butter or 14 cup unsalted margarine 1 12 cups sugar 2 eggs 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 teaspoon baking soda 14 cup water 1 cup mashed ripe banana 1 12 cups flour 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 cup chocolate chips 1 teaspoon flour._SEP_Beat butter, sugar, eggs, and vanilla._SEP_Dissolve baking soda in water and add to batter; beat well._SEP_Add bananas._SEP_Add dry ingredients; blend._SEP_Pour chocolate chips into a separate bowl and mix with the remaining teaspoon of flour before adding to the batter (this can keep the chips from sinking to the bottom of the pan)._SEP_Pour into a 9-inch square baking pan or bundt pan.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Angel Hair Pasta with Ancho Chile Sauce Ingredients: 4 ancho chilesstems, seeds, and veins removed 2 1/2 cups chicken stock or water 2 whole cloves 1 garlic clove, coarsely chopped 1/8 teaspoon cumin seeds Salt 1/4 cup vegetable oil 4 ounces angel hair pasta or very fine vermicelli, preferably in nests or skeins 1/3 cup finely grated queso anejo or Romano cheese, avocado slices and quartered limes._SEP_In a nonreactive medium sauce-pan, cover the chiles with water and simmer for 5 minutes._SEP_Remove from the heat and let soak until soft, 5 more minutes._SEP_Drain._SEP_Pour 1/4 cup of the chicken stock into the blender, add the cloves, garlic and cumin seeds and blend until smooth._SEP_Season with salt._SEP_Add 1 more cup of the stock and the drained chiles, a few at a time, and blend until smooth, adding more stock if necessary._SEP_Heat the oil in a large heavy saucepan.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Pork Loin With Herb Crust Ingredients: 4 -5 lbs loin pork rib racks, bone-in 1 tablespoon olive oil 3 large garlic cloves, minced or 34 teaspoon garlic powder 1 12 teaspoons kosher salt 1 12 teaspoons basil 1 12 teaspoons thyme 1 12 teaspoons parsley 1 12 teaspoons rosemary 1 tablespoon coarse black pepper 34 cup butter, cut up (or margarine) 12 cup all-purpose flour 4 cups chicken stock 2 teaspoons tomato paste 1 teaspoon rubbed sage 14 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper._SEP_Preheat oven to 350 degrees._SEP_Combine the olive oil with the garlic, salt, basil, thyme, parsley, rosemary and black pepper._SEP_Rub the pork all over with olive oil and herb mixture._SEP_Place the pork on a rack and roast at 350 degrees for 1 hour and 15 minutes, or until a meat thermometer inserted into the thickest portion registers 150 degrees._SEP_The temperature will rise about 10 degrees while resting._SEP_If you prefer a higher than 160 degree final temp., cook longer as desired._SEP_Transfer to a serving tray, cover and let rest while making the sauce._SEP_For the sauce, pour the pan drippings into a skillet._SEP_Add the butter; cook over medium heat until melted.
gen_body: Sprinkle the flour over the butter and stir until combined._SEP_Cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly._SEP_Gradually whisk in the chicken stock, tomato paste, sage, and black pepper._SEP_Bring the mixture to a boil and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened._SEP_Taste and adjust seasoning as necessary._SEP_Serve the pork with the sauce spooned over the top._SEP_If you want to mix things up a bit, try adding some additional herbs or spices to the herb crust, such as oregano or thyme._SEP_You could also try adding some chopped nuts or breadcrumbs for additional texture._SEP_When selecting your pork loin, look for a piece of meat with a layer of fat on top._SEP_This will help keep the meat moist and tender during cooking._SEP_If your pork loin doesn't have a layer of fat, ask your butcher to tie bacon around it to achieve the same effect._SEP_To ensure even cooking, take your pork loin out of the refrigerator and let it come to room temperature for about 30 minutes before cooking._SEP_This will help the meat cook more evenly and prevent it from drying out._SEP_If you don't have a meat thermometer, you can check if your pork loin is cooked by piercing it with a fork._SEP_If the juices run clear, the meat is cooked through._SEP_If there's still pink in the center, cook for an additional 10-15 minutes until done._SEP_Leftover pork loin is great for sandwiches or salads._SEP_Simply slice it thinly and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3-4 days._SEP_Finally, don't forget to let your pork loin rest for at least 10 minutes before slicing and serving._SEP_This allows the juices to redistribute and ensures that the meat will be juicy and tender._SEP_Enjoy!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Fattoush- Pita Bread Salad Ingredients: 3 medium pita breads 1 -1 12 lb tomatoes 3 ounces romaine lettuce, chopped 1 medium cucumber, peeled,seeded and cubed 12 cup scallion, chopped (including about half of the green part) 12 cup fresh parsley 13 cup olive oil 14 cup lemon juice 2 tablespoons dried mint or 4 -6 tablespoons of fresh mint, snipped salt and pepper, to taste nonstick cooking spray 12 teaspoon garlic salt (optional)._SEP_Preheat oven to 375._SEP_Split the pita breads into rounds and cut each round into 1 1/2-inch pieces._SEP_Place the bread on a baking sheet, and spray it with garlic-flavored olive oil spray._SEP_If you don't have any garlic-flavored spray, spray with olive oil spray (or drizzle with olive oil), and sprinkle lightly with garlic powder._SEP_Bake the bread in a preheated oven for 12 minutes, turning once, till it's completely dry and crisp._SEP_Set it aside to cool._SEP_About 10 minutes before you're ready to serve the salad, place the bread in a large bowl, and add the remaining ingredients._SEP_Toss to combine and serve within 15 minutes or so.

prompt_body: No subject in recent years has focused the art world's attention on the vexing question of the relationship between art and politics as has the AIDS epidemic._SEP_Understandably, documentary photography has been at the center of the continuing debates over what role, if any, art can play in mobilizing public opinion about AIDS._SEP_Now a new show by Brian Weil, at the midtown Manhattan branch of the International Center of Photography through July 21, makes an ambitious attempt to provide an overview, in photographs and words, of the AIDS epidemic._SEP_The result brings into focus some of the unresolvable questions about photography's role as a medium of persuasion and education._SEP_Mr. Weil's presentation consists of a series of large, grainy black-and-white prints depicting diverse aspects of the AIDS crisis, from patients afflicted with AIDS-related diseases to men in a drug shooting gallery in Chicago and the making of a gay safe-sex video._SEP_In one exceptionally gripping series, Mr. Weil presents the story of a New York family in which first one child, then another, then the father, all develop AIDS-related diseases and eventually die._SEP_Mr. Weil has also photographed the impact of AIDS in other countries, and presents images of traditional healers in South Africa and Haiti who offer dubious treatments; of transvestites in the Dominican Republic, recruited by the government to promote safe-sex practices; of heroin addicts in Bangkok; and so on._SEP_In recording the impact of AIDS around the world Mr. Weil presents it not simply as a series of unrelated individual tragedies but as a public-health problem that is global in scope.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Arancine with Sardines Ingredients: 2 tablespoons plus 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 1 red onion, chopped into 1/8-inch dice 1 pinch saffron 2 cups arborio rice 3 cups chicken stock 1 cup grated pecorino 2 eggs plus 2 eggs separated 1 cup basic tomato sauce, recipe follows 8 ounces salted sardines, rinsed, heads removed and roughly chopped 2 sprigs mint 1/4 cup flour for dusting 1/2 cup breadcrumbs for coating Extra-virgin olive oil for frying._SEP_To make the rice: In a 4 to 6-quart saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil until just smoking._SEP_Add half the chopped red onion and saffron, and cook until softened, about 7 to 9 minutes._SEP_Add rice and chicken stock, and bring to boil, uncovered._SEP_Cook until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender, about 25 minutes._SEP_Spread rice out to cool on a large cookie sheet, about 1/4-inch to 1/2-inch thick._SEP_When rice is cool, mix with the Pecorino, 2 eggs, and 2 egg yolks, and set aside_SEP_To make the stuffing: In a 10 to 12-inch saute pan, cook the remaining chopped onion in 2 tablespoons olive oil until light golden brown, about 10 minutes._SEP_Add the tomato sauce, chopped sardines, and mint, and cook 5 to 7 minutes until reduced by one third and quite thick.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Coconut Rice (Arroz con Coco) Ingredients: 3 cups long-grain white rice 6 cups light coconut milk 1 tablespoon, plus 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup raisins 1/2 cup toasted coconut flakes._SEP_Place the rice, 3/4 cup of water, the coconut milk, sugar and the salt in a medium saucepan and stir to combine._SEP_Bring the rice to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until the water has evaporated to just below the level of the rice and little holes begin to form on the surface, stirring occasionally so that the rice doesn't stick to the bottom of the pan and burn._SEP_Reduce the heat to the lowest setting, cover the saucepan and continue to cook until the rice is tender, 20 to 25 minutes.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Authentic Vegetable Chow Mein Ingredients: 8 ounces fresh thin Chinese egg noodles 1 tablespoon soy sauce 1 tablespoon rice wine (preferably Shaoxing) or 1 tablespoon medium-dry sherry 1 tablespoon oyster sauce 1 teaspoon cornstarch 14 teaspoon white pepper 12 cup reduced-sodium chicken broth 14 cup peanut oil (or less) 1 teaspoon finely chopped peeled fresh ginger 1 teaspoon finely chopped garlic 3 scallions, cut into 2 1/2-inch pieces (1 cup) 5 ounces fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems discarded and caps quartered (2 1/2 cups) 6 ounces choy sum, cut into 2 1/2-inch pieces (2 1/2 cups) or 6 ounces inch-wide broccoli florets._SEP_Bring 8 cups unsalted water to a boil in a 6- to 8-quart pot, then add noodles, stirring to separate, and cook 15 seconds._SEP_Drain in a colander and rinse under cold water until noodles are cool, then shake colander briskly to drain excess water._SEP_Stir together soy sauce, rice wine, oyster sauce, and cornstarch with 1/4 teaspoon white pepper in a small bowl until smooth, then stir in chicken broth._SEP_Heat wok over high heat until a drop of water evaporates within 1 to 2 seconds of contact, then add 1/2 cup peanut oil and heat until just smoking._SEP_Carefully add noodles all at once, flattening top to form a 9-inch cake._SEP_Cook until underside is golden, 4 to 5 minutes, rotating noodle cake with a metal spatula to brown evenly and lifting edges occasionally to check color._SEP_Carefully flip noodle cake over with spatula and tongs, then cook, rotating cake, until other side is golden, 2 to 3 minutes more._SEP_Transfer noodle cake to a large paper-towel-lined plate to drain excess oil._SEP_Discard any oil remaining in wok and wipe out wok with paper towels.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Braised Chicken with Mushrooms and Almonds Ingredients: Extra-virgin olive oil 8 chicken thighs Kosher salt 1/2 pound pancetta, cut into 1/2-inch dice 2 large onions, julienned Pinch crushed red pepper flakes 4 cloves garlic, smashed 2 pounds assorted mushrooms, such as shiitake, oyster or cremini, cleaned and sliced 2 cups dry white wine 4 to 6 cups chicken stock 1 bundle thyme 4 bay leaves 1/2 cup whole blanched almonds, toasted Sauteed Haricots Verts, recipe follows Chopped chives, for garnish 1/2 pound haricots verts (baby string beans), stem ends removed Extra-virgin olive oil 2 garlic cloves, smashed Pinch crushed red pepper flakes Kosher salt._SEP_Coat a large, wide, deep pan with olive oil and bring to a high heat._SEP_Pat the chicken skin dry with paper towels and season generously with salt._SEP_Add chicken skin side down to the pan._SEP_You should hear a big sizzle as the thighs hit the pan._SEP_Do not try to move the chicken, the skin will stick itself to the bottom of the pan and will unstick itself when it is ready.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Simple Baklava Ingredients: 1/2 cup almonds 1/2 cup walnuts 1/4 cup chopped dried apricots 1/4 cup plain bread crumbs 2 tablespoons sugar 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves Pinch of salt 1 stick butter, melted, divided 3 tablespoons honey 12 sheets phyllo dough._SEP_Special equipment: 2 mini-muffin tins_SEP_Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F._SEP_Place the almonds, walnuts, apricots, bread crumbs, sugar, cinnamon, ground cloves, and salt in a food processor._SEP_Run the machine until the mixture is very finely chopped._SEP_Transfer the mixture to a small bowl._SEP_Add 2 tablespoons of the melted butter and the honey and stir to combine._SEP_On a dry work surface place 1 sheet of phyllo._SEP_Using a pastry brush and the remaining melted butter, lightly cover the entire sheet of phyllo with melted butter._SEP_Cover the first sheet with a second sheet of phyllo and brush with melted butter.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Mamma Mia Minestrone Soup Ingredients: 14 lb pepperoni, rind removed and chopped 13 cup vegetable oil 1 large onion, coarsely chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 stalk celery, cut into 1/4 inch slices 3 carrots, pared and diced into 1/4 inch cubes 2 medium zucchini, quartered and thickly sliced 1 cup shredded red cabbage or 1 cup green cabbage 1 (28 ounce) can Italian plum tomatoes, with juice,chopped 12 teaspoon salt 5 cups beef broth 2 teaspoons dried basil 12 teaspoon dried thyme 1 (19 ounce) canwhite cannellini beans, drained (white kidney beans) granted parmesan cheese._SEP_In a small saucepan simmer the pepperoni, in water to cover, for 5 minues: drain off water._SEP_In large soup pot saute the pepperoni, onion and garlic in vegetable oil, stirring till veggies are clear._SEP_Add the carrots, celery, zucchini and cabbage._SEP_Cook and stir for 2- 3 minutes._SEP_Add tomatoes and juice, salt and beef broth, then add basil and thyme._SEP_Cover and simmer at least 2 hours._SEP_Taste soup and add water or more broth if needed, and correct seasoning._SEP_Add the drained beans for the last 15 minutes of cooking._SEP_This soup will be rather thick.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Roasted Asparagus and Red Onion Quesadillas Ingredients: 1 pound asparagus, trimmed 3 tablespoons olive oil 1 large red onion, cut crosswise into 1/4-inch-thick slices and separated into rings eight 6- to 7-inch flour tortillas 1/2 pound pepper Jack cheese, coarsely shredded 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh coriander 1/2 cup sour cream 1 teaspoon ground cumin 1 teaspoon fresh lime juice._SEP_Preheat oven to 500F._SEP_In a large shallow baking pan, toss asparagus with 1 1/2 teaspoons oil and salt and pepper to taste until coated well._SEP_In another large shallow baking pan, toss onion with 1 1/2 teaspoons oil until coated well._SEP_Roast vegetables in upper and lower thirds of oven, shaking pans occasionally and switching position of pans in oven halfway through baking, until tender and lightly browned, about 10 minutes._SEP_Cool vegetables and cut asparagus into 1/2-inch-thick slices._SEP_Preheat broiler._SEP_Grease a large baking sheet.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Ribeye Steak With Red Wine Sauce - Atkins - 5 Net Carbs Ingredients: 14 cup olive oil 2 boneless rib eye steaks, 1 lb each, about 1/2-inch thick 2 tablespoons butter 4 garlic cloves, large, minced 13 cup shallot, finely chopped 1 cup red wine 12 cup beef broth, reduced sodium 12 teaspoon pepper, freshly ground salt tarragon rosemary._SEP_Note: If you have access to fresh herbs, add some chopped tarragon or rosemary to the sauce (optional)._SEP_Heat 2 tbsp oil in large heavy skillet over med-high heat, until hot, but not smoking.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Cane Vinegar Chicken with Pearl Onions, Orange, and Spinach Ingredients: 4 chicken thighs, each weighing about 5 to 6 ounces 1/2 teaspoon sea salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 2 tablespoons unsalted butter 16 pearl onions, peeled 1/4 teaspoon hot smoked paprika 3 garlic cloves, thinly sliced 1 cup cane vinegar 1 cup chicken stock 2 large navel oranges, cut into supremes 1 tablespoon fresh mint leaves 2 cups cleaned spinach (stems removed)._SEP_Season the thighs with the salt and pepper.In a wide, heavy-bottomed pot that has a lid, melt the butter over medium heat._SEP_Add the thighs, skin side down, and let them cook without moving them around for 7 minutes._SEP_You are encouraging good caramelization of the skin and developing a ton of flavor in the process._SEP_After 7 minutes turn the thighs over and add the onions, paprika, and garlic to the pot._SEP_Cook for 5 minutes and then add the vinegar, being careful not to let it flame up.This is a good time to get a spatula and loosen up all of those pan drippings._SEP_The vinegar needs to cook down by half, and when it does, add the stock._SEP_Cover and reduce the heat to low._SEP_Cook for 20 minutes over low heat, remove the lid, and add the oranges, mint, and spinach._SEP_Stir lightly and serve immediately.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Coffee Spice Cake Ingredients: 34 cup cold strong coffee 34 cup shortening 1 12 cups dark brown sugar 14 cup molasses 3 large eggs 2 12 cups cake flour 3 teaspoons baking powder 14 teaspoon baking soda 14 teaspoon salt 14 teaspoon ground ginger 1 12 teaspoons ground cinnamon 14 teaspoon ground cloves 14 teaspoon ground nutmeg._SEP_Make the coffee; use dark roast._SEP_Position oven rack in the center of oven; preheat to 350._SEP_Prepare 12-cup Bundt pan as follows: Prepare Bundt pan using the following methodmake a paste from 1 tablespoon melted butter and 1 tablespoon flour ; apply it with a pastry brush, you can thoroughly coat the surface of the pan, including all the nooks and crannies (or use your preferred method to prepare Bundt pan for baking a cake).
gen_body: 1._SEP_In a mixing bowl, cream the shortening, brown sugar, and molasses together until well combined._SEP_Add in the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.2._SEP_In a separate bowl, whisk together the cake flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, ginger, cinnamon, cloves, and nutmeg.3._SEP_Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture, alternating with the cold coffee, until the batter is smooth.4._SEP_Pour the batter into the prepared Bundt pan and smooth it out evenly.5._SEP_Bake the cake for 40-45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.6._SEP_Remove from the oven and let cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.7._SEP_Once cooled, dust with powdered sugar, sprinkle with chopped nuts or decorate as desired._SEP_Serve and enjoy!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Salmon Shepherds Pie Ingredients: 4 whole Large Russet Potatoes 2 Tablespoons Butter 2 Tablespoons Flour 1- 1/4 cup Milk 1/2 teaspoons Salt 1/2 teaspoons Black Pepper, Or To Taste 1 teaspoon Dry Mustard 1/2 teaspoons Dried Tarragon 8 ounces, weight Cheese, Cheddar Or Your Preference 16 ounces, weight Salmon, Cooked And Chunked 16 ounces, weight Peas, Frozen Or Fresh._SEP_Preheat oven to 350 degrees F._SEP_The first thing I do is make the mashed potatoes._SEP_It really doesnt matter how you make them; use whatever tried-and-true recipe for mashers you already know._SEP_You can even use instant, if you roll that way._SEP_The one change I make is that I peel my potatoes for this one._SEP_Make your cheese sauce._SEP_Melt the butter in a saucepan and whisk the flour into it._SEP_Cook on medium heat until its creamy and bubbling, about a minute._SEP_Pour the milk in slowly and whisk constantly until it just comes to a boil.
gen_body: Add the salt, pepper, dry mustard, and tarragon, and continue stirring until it thickens._SEP_Once the sauce has thickened, add in the cheese and stir until it melts completely._SEP_You can add more or less cheese depending on how cheesy you want your pie to be._SEP_In a separate bowl, mix together the salmon and peas._SEP_You can use fresh or frozen peas, but make sure they are cooked before adding them to the mixture._SEP_Once the salmon and peas are mixed, pour in the cheese sauce and stir until everything is combined._SEP_Pour the mixture into a baking dish and smooth out the top._SEP_Then, gently spoon the mashed potatoes on top of the salmon mixture, spreading it evenly._SEP_You can use a fork to create a pattern or design on top of the mashed potatoes if you want._SEP_Bake the salmon shepherd's pie in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, until the top is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly._SEP_Let it cool for a few minutes before serving._SEP_This recipe makes about 6 servings, so it's perfect for feeding a family or for meal prep._SEP_You can even freeze any leftovers and heat them up later for a quick and easy dinner._SEP_Enjoy your delicious and comforting salmon shepherd's pie!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Avocado, Beet and Arugula Salad with Chevre Tartine Ingredients: 4 ounces goat cheese, softened 1 teaspoon dried basil 4 (1/2 inch thick) slices crusty bread 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar salt and pepper to taste 1/4 cup olive oil 1 (15 ounce) can sliced beets, drained and diced 1 (10 ounce) package mixed salad greens with arugula 2 avocados - peeled, pitted and diced 1/3 cup chopped toasted hazelnuts._SEP_Preheat broiler for high heat.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Green Chili Ingredients: 2 poblano peppers (whichever you can get fresh) or 2 anaheim chilies (whichever you can get fresh) 1 jalapeno 16 ounces black beans 16 ounces kidney beans 3 tablespoons minced garlic cloves 4 tablespoons butter 12 onion 4 cups water 1 chicken bouillon cube 1 vegetable bouillon cube (preferably tomato) 1 (4 ounce) can salsa verde 1 (4 ounce) can green chilies (you pick mild or hot) white pepper cumin cilantro tortilla sour cream._SEP_Melt butter in your sauce pot._SEP_Chop your onion and poblanos and jalapeno and add to butter,(adding the onions first gives them time to caramelize; then add your chopped peppers and let cook)._SEP_Add garlic to peppers and onions, don't let the garlic brown (it will turn bitter in flavor)._SEP_Add your salsa verde, black beans, kidney beans and green chilies (I rinsed my beans)._SEP_Add 4 cups of water and the bouillon cubes._SEP_Add cumin and white pepper to taste.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Rabbit and Vegetable Pot Pie Ingredients: 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil Flour for dredging 3 rabbits, cut into serving pieces 5 large shallots, minced 3 cloves garlic, minced 16 pearl onions 1 pound mixed fresh wild mushrooms such as shiitake and chanterelle, julienned 1/2 pound fresh domestic mushrooms, sliced 1 cup carrot, julienned 1 cup peeled turnip, julienned 1 cup sliced celery 1/4 cup tomato paste 3 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon 4 cups dry white wine 1/2 cup brandy 8 cups chicken stock Bouquet garni (parsley, thyme, bay leaf, peppercorns and cloves tied in a cheesecloth) 4 tomatoes, peeled, quartered and seeded 1 1/2 cups raw peas 2 tablespoons cornstarch dissolved in 1/4 cup water Coarse salt and freshly ground pepper to taste 2 pounds puff pastry 2 eggs, beaten with a pinch of salt._SEP_Preheat oven to 350 degrees._SEP_Heat oil in a large saute pan._SEP_Lightly flour rabbit pieces and brown in batches in the oil._SEP_Remove rabbit and set aside._SEP_In the same pan, lightly brown the shallots, garlic and onions in oil remaining in the pan._SEP_Add mushrooms, carrot, turnip and celery and cook for a minute more._SEP_Stir in tomato paste and tarragon.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Creamy Mushroom Soup Ingredients: 1 ounce dried morel 1 ounce dried porcini mushrooms 6 cups boiling water, to soak the mushrooms or 6 cups vegetable broth 4 tablespoons butter 1 onion, cut into 1/4 in dice 3 garlic cloves, minced 18 lb wild mushroom, cleaned and coarsely chopped 14 cup madeira wine or 14 cup cognac 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped, for garnish 14 cup heavy cream salt and black pepper._SEP_Place dried mushrooms in a medium bowl and pour in the boiling water._SEP_Let stand 15 minutes, or until mushrooms are softened._SEP_Remove mushrooms with a slotted spoon, chop and set aside._SEP_Pour the mushroom liquid through a fine sieve or cheesecloth into a bowl; discard solids and remaining sand._SEP_Reserve.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Texas Style Burgers Ingredients: 2 lbs ground chuck Velveeta cheese butter or margarine 1 loaf texas toast or 1 loaf garlic bread 1 pint bell peppers in tomato sauce vidalia onion, sliced (optional)._SEP_Make ground chuck into 6 patties and fry in large skillet._SEP_When burgers are done add a slice of Velveeta to each, turn burner down, cover and let melt._SEP_In another large skillet lightly butter Texas Toast or garlic bread and brown on both sides._SEP_Place burgers on toast and add bell peppers._SEP_Add large slice of Vidalia onion to each if desired.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Bierocks Ingredients: 2 cups warm water 2 tablespoons yeast 14 cup sugar 1 egg, lightly beaten 14 cup oil or 14 cup melted butter 6 12 cups flour, divided 1 12 teaspoons salt 1 12 lbs ground meat 12 cup onion, chopped 3 cups cabbage, finely chopped 1 12 teaspoons salt 12 teaspoon black pepper 1 dash Tabasco sauce._SEP_For dough:._SEP_Combine 2 cups warm water, 2 packages yeast and 1/4 cup sugar.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Old Fashioned Oatmeal Cookies Ingredients: 1 cup butter or 1 cup margarine 1 12 cups brown sugar, packed 2 cups flour 2 cups rolled oats 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon baking soda 14 cup boiling water 1 teaspoon vanilla._SEP_Dissolve the baking soda in boiling water._SEP_In a large Dutch oven, melt the butter or margarine._SEP_Add rest of ingredients and mix well.

prompt_body: People work their ass off in this country._SEP_They labour ten hours a day on a standard week, but it doesn't stop there._SEP_There are weekend voluntary building projects, city clean up days, volunteer babysitting... If you look at statistics, we may be the most altruistic country in the world, but what you don't know, is that this is the bare minimum to survive in this country._SEP_It is a well known, unspoken fact that our country's population has skyrocketed in recent years thanks to the recent baby boom._SEP_Approximately 30,000 babies are born each day._SEP_This means that 30,000 people must die each day._SEP_Of course, who do you pick off but the scum of society, and after that, the diseased, the elderly, and then what?_SEP_You pick the ones who have added least value to society, the unemployed, and finally, the ones who engage the least in community activities._SEP_Now as with all policies, there is an exception to the rule, and I am one of those exceptions._SEP_Or, I was.
gen_body: I used to be one of the most active volunteers in my community._SEP_I would attend every event, help with every project, and even organize some myself._SEP_But then, I lost my job._SEP_I applied to multiple positions every day, but nothing seemed to work out._SEP_I wasn't lazy or unskilled, but the job market was just too competitive._SEP_Months went by and my savings dwindled._SEP_I didn't want to burden my family or friends, so I tried to keep up with my volunteer work to show that I was still contributing to society._SEP_But then, one day, I got a notice in the mail._SEP_I was selected for euthanasia._SEP_I couldn't believe it._SEP_All of my hard work, my dedication to my community, and my contributions meant nothing._SEP_I was just a number, a statistic in the population control system._SEP_I tried to fight it, but the government was adamant._SEP_They said I was a burden to society, that I wasn't contributing enough, that I was taking up valuable resources._SEP_It was a dark time for me, realizing that all of my efforts were just a means to an end._SEP_But I didn't give up._SEP_I formed a group with others who were in the same situation as me, fighting for our right to live._SEP_We protested, we lobbied, we did everything we could to show that we were valuable members of society, even if we were unemployed._SEP_And eventually, we won._SEP_The government realized that their population control policies were too harsh, too ruthless._SEP_They loosened the requirements for euthanasia and provided more support for those who were struggling._SEP_It wasn't perfect, but it was a step in the right direction._SEP_Now, I am still unemployed, but I am no longer living in fear of being selected for euthanasia._SEP_I still volunteer when I can, but I also spend my time advocating for those who are still fighting for their right to live._SEP_It may be a small victory, but it is a victory nonetheless.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Turkey Chipotle Meatloaf Recipe Ingredients: Cooking spray 1 cup fresh white breadcrumbs (about 3 ounces) 1/2 cup whole milk 3 thick strips applewood-smoked bacon, coarsely chopped 3 large eggs, beaten 1 cup ketchup 1 (7-ounce) can chipotle chiles in adobo sauce, minced 1 large yellow onion, finely chopped 1 celery stalk, finely chopped 2 tablespoons finely chopped cilantro leaves 2 teaspoons finely chopped flat-leaf parsley leaves 1 1/2 teaspoons ancho chile powder 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika 1 tablespoon kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 2 pounds ground dark-meat turkey._SEP_Heat the oven to 400 degrees F and arrange a rack in the upper third._SEP_Generously coat a rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray and set it aside.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Strawberry Basil Roll Ingredients: 4 Eggs 1 pinch Salt 4 Tablespoons Granulated Sugar, Divided 3 Tablespoons All-purpose Flour 3 Tablespoons Cornstarch Extra Icing Sugar For Sprinkling And Decorating 4 leaves Gelatine 2 whole Organic Limes, Juice And Some Zest 23 cups Icing Sugar 6 sprigs Basil 9 ounces, weight Low-fat Quark 5 ounces, weight Strawberries 1 cup Heavy Cream 6 Strawberries For Decorating, Optional 1 cup Heavy Cream For Decorating, Optional Almond Slices, Optional Coconut Flakes (optional)._SEP_Preheat the oven to 200 C/400 F. yolk mixture._SEP_Gently fold in the egg whites until the mixture is well combined, being careful not to deflate the mixture._SEP_Pour the mixture onto the prepared baking tray and spread it evenly with a spatula._SEP_Bake in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until the sponge is golden and springs back when touched._SEP_While the sponge is baking, prepare the filling._SEP_Soak the gelatine remove it from the oven and immediately turn it out onto a clean tea towel dusted with icing sugar._SEP_Peel off the baking paper and roll the sponge in the towel while it is still warm._SEP_Leave to cool for 10 minutes._SEP_Unroll the sponge and spread the quark mixture over the top, leaving a 1-inch border around the edge._SEP_Arrange the sliced strawberries on top of the quark mixture._SEP_In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form._SEP_Spread the whipped cream over the top of the strawberries._SEP_Carefully roll the sponge up again, using the tea towel to help prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Bone-in Rib-Eye Steak with Marchand di Vin Sauce Ingredients: 1/2 cup vegetable oil 1/2 cup Creole seasoning, recipe follows 4 bone-in Dry Aged Rib-Eye steaks, (about 20 to 22 ounces each) 1 tablespoon butter 1/4 cup chopped shallots 1 tablespoon garlic 1/4 cup dry red wine 1 cup demi-glace 4 cups Mashed Potatoes, (hot), recipe follows 1 tablespoon finely chopped fresh parsley leaves 2 1/2 tablespoons paprika 2 tablespoons salt 2 tablespoons garlic powder 1 tablespoon black pepper 1 tablespoon onion powder 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper 1 tablespoon dried oregano 1 tablespoon dried thyme 2 pounds potatoes, peeled and diced 4 ounces (1 stick) butter, cubed 1/2 to 3/4 cup heavy cream Salt and white pepper._SEP_In a small bowl, combine the oil and Creole seasoning._SEP_Mix well._SEP_Spread each side of the steaks completely with the Creole seasoning mixture._SEP_Place in a shallow pan, cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours._SEP_Remove and bring to room temperature before grilling, about 30 minutes._SEP_Preheat the grill._SEP_In a saucepan, over medium heat, melt the butter._SEP_Add the shallots and garlic._SEP_Season with salt and pepper.
gen_body: Cook until the shallots are translucent, about 2 to 3 minutes._SEP_Add the wine and deglaze the pan, scraping up any brown bits on the bottom of the pan._SEP_Reduce by half._SEP_Add the demi-glace and cook until the sauce thickens, about 4 to 5 minutes._SEP_Keep warm._SEP_For the mashed potatoes, bring a pot of salted water to a boil._SEP_Add the potatoes and cook until tender, about 15 to 20 minutes._SEP_Drain well._SEP_Return the potatoes to the pot and add the butter._SEP_Mash the potatoes with a potato masher or fork._SEP_Add the cream, a little at a time, and continue to mash until the potatoes are smooth and creamy._SEP_Season with salt and white pepper, to taste._SEP_Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F._SEP_Grill the steaks for 6 to 8 minutes on each side for medium rare, or until desired doneness._SEP_Transfer the steaks to a baking sheet and place in the oven to keep warm while making the sauce._SEP_To serve, divide the mashed potatoes evenly among 4 plates._SEP_Top each with a steak and spoon the Marchand di Vin sauce over the top._SEP_Sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately._SEP_For the Creole seasoning: In a bowl, combine the paprika, salt, garlic powder, black pepper, onion powder, cayenne, oregano and thyme._SEP_Mix well and store in an airtight container._SEP_Serves: 4

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Candied Papaya Parfaits Recipe Ingredients: 6 c. water 1/2 tsp baking soda 2 x not-quite-ripe papayas - (abt 3 lbs total) halved, seeds scraped out, peeled, cut 2" by 1/2" strips 5 whl cloves 1 1/2 c. coarsely-grated piloncillo brown sugar 1 c. granulated sugar 1 x cinnamon stick cracked in half 1/2 c. heavy cream 2 Tbsp. powdered sugar 1/4 c. lowfat sour cream 1 c. crumbled or possibly grated queso blanco 1/2 c. unsweetened grated coconut for garnish (or possibly mint leaves)._SEP_Combine the water and baking soda in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil._SEP_Add in the papaya pcs and cook for 5 min over medium heat._SEP_With a slotted spoon, carefully transfer the fruit strips to a platter lined with paper towels; set aside._SEP_Meanwhile, toast the cloves in a small skillet till fragrant, about 1 minute, and lightly crush them._SEP_Add in the crushed cloves, piloncillo, granulated sugar and cinnamon to the papaya cooking liquid and cook over medium-high heat till the syrup is thick sufficient to thinly coat the back of a wooden spoon._SEP_Return the papaya to the pan and cook for 30 min over medium heat._SEP_The syrup will turn a very dark amber._SEP_Let the papaya cold in the syrup, then transfer it, along with the syrup, to a bowl._SEP_Cover and chill overnight.
gen_body: To assemble the parfaits, whip the heavy cream and powdered sugar together until stiff peaks form._SEP_Fold in the sour cream and mix well._SEP_To serve, spoon some of the candied papaya into the bottom of individual parfait glasses._SEP_Add a spoonful of the whipped cream mixture on top of the papaya._SEP_Sprinkle some crumbled or grated queso blanco on top of the cream._SEP_Repeat the layers until the parfait glasses are full._SEP_Finish by topping the parfaits with grated unsweetened coconut or a sprig of fresh mint leaves._SEP_Serve chilled._SEP_This candied papaya parfait recipe is a perfect dessert for a special occasion or when you want to impress your guests with something unique and exotic._SEP_Papaya is a tropical fruit that is abundant in many countries and is full of vitamins and nutrients._SEP_It is not often used in desserts but this recipe will change your mind about that._SEP_The papaya is cooked in a rich, dark syrup that is flavored with cinnamon and cloves._SEP_The syrup is what gives the fruit its sweet, sticky texture and deep, caramel flavor._SEP_Piloncillo sugar is a typical ingredient in Mexican cuisine and is made by boiling and evaporating sugar cane juice until it crystallizes._SEP_It has a distinct molasses-like flavor that adds complexity to the syrup._SEP_The queso blanco is a mild, crumbly cheese that complements the sweet flavors of the fruit and syrup._SEP_The unsweetened grated coconut adds a crunchy texture to the parfait and a tropical touch._SEP_Making this recipe takes some time, but it is worth it._SEP_The candied papaya can be made in advance and stored in the fridge for several days._SEP_The whipped cream mixture can also be prepared ahead of time and kept in the fridge until ready to serve._SEP_The parfaits can be assembled just before serving, making them a convenient dessert option for a dinner party or a special treat for yourself.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Chocolate Truffle Cake Ingredients: 4 ounces bittersweet or semisweet chocolate, cut into small pieces 3 tablespoons, heavy cream 1 tablespoon unsalted butter 2 tablespoons flavoring of your choice (orange, almond, or raspberry liqueur, etc.) 8 fresh perfect raspberries, optional 5 ounces bittersweet chocolate, cut into small pieces 5 ounces unsalted butter, cut into small pieces 3 eggs, at room temperature 3 egg yolks, at room temperature 1/2 cup sugar 5 tablespoons plus 1 teaspoon all-purpose flour Whipped Cream, optional Ice Cream, optional._SEP_For the truffles: Combine the chocolate, cream and butter in a small heatproof bowl set over simmering water and let melt._SEP_When almost melted, remove from heat and stir the mixture until smooth.

Kennedy on January 9, 1961._SEP_I have welcomed this opportunity to address this historic body, and, through you, the people of Massachusetts to whom I am so deeply indebted for a lifetime of friendship and trust._SEP_For fourteen years I have placed my confidence in the citizens of Massachusetts -- and they have generously responded by placing their confidence in me._SEP_Now, on the Friday after next, I am to assume new and broader responsibilities._SEP_But I am not here to bid farewell to Massachusetts._SEP_For forty-three years -- whether I was in London, Washington, the South Pacific, or elsewhere -- this has been my home; and, God willing, wherever I serve this shall remain my home._SEP_It was here my grandparents were born -- it is here I hope my grandchildren will be born._SEP_I speak neither from false provincial pride nor artful political flattery._SEP_For no man about to enter high office in this country can ever be unmindful of the contribution this state has made to our national greatness._SEP_Its leaders have shaped our destiny long before the great republic was born.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Osso Buco alla Milanese Ingredients: All-purpose flour for dredging (about 1/2 cup) 4 meaty veal shanks, each 2 to 2 1/2 inches thick (3 to 3 1/2 pounds total) Coarse salt and freshly ground black pepper 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 3 tablespoons unsalted butter 1 medium yellow onion (about 6 ounces), chopped into 1/2-inch pieces 1 medium carrot, chopped into 1/2-inch pieces 1 celery stalk with leaves, chopped into 1/2-inch pieces 1 small fennel bulb (about 12 ounces), trimmed, cored, and chopped into 1/2-inch pieces 3 garlic cloves, minced 2 strips orange zest, removed with a vegetable peeler (each about 3 inches by 3/4-inch) 1 1/2 teaspoons chopped fresh marjoram or 1/2 teaspoon dried 1 bay leaf 1 cup dry white wine or dry white vermouth 1/2 cup veal or chicken stock, homemade, or store-bought 1 cup chopped peeled tomatoes, fresh or canned, with their juice 2 tablespoons chopped flat-leaf parsley 1 teaspoon minced garlic 1 teaspoon grated lemon zest._SEP_Heat the oven to 300 degrees._SEP_Dredging the shanks: pour the flour into a shallow dish (a pie plate works nicely)._SEP_Season the veal shanks on all sides with salt and pepper.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Nana's Slow Cooked Meaty Tomato Sauce Ingredients: 1 pound sweet Italian sausage, casings removed 1 pound hot Italian sausage, casings removed 1/2 pound ground beef 1 large onion, finely diced 1/4 cup minced garlic, or to taste 4 (14.5 ounce) cans diced tomatoes 2 (6 ounce) cans tomato paste 2 (14 ounce) cans tomato sauce 1/2 cup chicken broth 1/2 cup Cabernet Sauvignon (or other dry red wine) 1 tablespoon dried Italian herb seasoning 1/2 cup chopped fresh basil 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper, or to taste._SEP_Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and stir in Italian sausage, ground beef, onion, and garlic._SEP_Cook and stir until the meat is crumbly, evenly browned, and no longer pink, about 15 minutes._SEP_Use a potato masher to mash and blend the meat mixture every few minutes.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Six Ingredient Pad See Ew Ingredients: 1 Tablespoon Vegetable Or Peanut Oil 1 clove Garlic, Minced 1 whole Small Shallot, Thinly Sliced 5 ounces, weight Fresh, Wide Rice Noodles 2 teaspoons Palm Sugar (substitute 1 Teaspoon White Sugar If Preferred) 1 Tablespoon Soy Sauce 20 whole Fresh Basil Leaves._SEP_Note: The recipe serves one, but can easily be doubled._SEP_I dont recommend making more than 2 servings at a time as it risks crowding the wok and resulting in a giant noodle blob._SEP_If you cannot find or prefer not to use fresh, wide rice noodles as in the original recipe, you can easily substitute thin, dry rice noodles._SEP_Just substitute 2.5 oz dry rice noodles for the fresh noodles._SEP_Soak the dry noodles in room temperature water until they become pliable (but not tender enough to eat), 10-12 minutes before beginning the dish._SEP_Because the noodles are soaked in water, the dish will need to cook a few minutes longer with dry noodles than with fresh._SEP_1._SEP_Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat._SEP_Add garlic and shallot and stir, cooking just until garlic begins to turn golden, about 1 minute.

gen_body: Divide the batter evenly among the prepared muffin cups, filling each about 2/3 full._SEP_Bake until a toothpick inserted in the center of a cupcake comes out clean, about 18 to 20 minutes._SEP_Let cool in the pan for 5 minutes, then transfer the cupcakes to a wire rack to cool completely._SEP_For the frosting: In the bowl of a large stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat the cream cheese and butter on medium-high speed until smooth and creamy, about 2 minutes._SEP_Add the confectioners' sugar, lime juice and salt and beat on low speed until just combined, then increase the speed to medium-high and beat until smooth and fluffy, about 2 minutes more._SEP_For the lime-sugar topping: Use a vegetable peeler to remove long strips of zest from the lime._SEP_Combine the strips of zest, granulated sugar and salt in a small bowl and use your fingers to massage the ingredients together until the sugar looks moist and fragrant with the lime oil._SEP_To assemble: Use a small offset spatula or knife to frost the cupcakes, then sprinkle each generously with the lime-sugar topping._SEP_Serve immediately or refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 3 days.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Creamy Tomato Soup With Oregano and Roasted Garlic Ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 small onion, finely chopped (about 1 cup) 1 (28 ounce) can diced tomatoes 2 cups warm vegetable stock 1 bulb roasted garlic (see instructions below) 14 cup fresh italian oregano leaves, loosely packed (3 tablespoons chopped) salt, to taste fresh ground pepper, to taste 1 cup heavy cream 2 teaspoons honey (optional) or 2 teaspoons sugar (optional)._SEP_In a nonreactive soup pot, heat oil over medium-low heat and add onion._SEP_Stir and saute for a minute or two._SEP_Cover, lower heat and sweat onions for about 3 minutes._SEP_Add tomatoes and stock to the pot, stir and increase heat to medium._SEP_Squeeze garlic cloves from their skins into the soup pot and add 1 tablespoon of the garlic- infused oil left from roasting.
gen_body: Stir in oregano and season with salt and pepper to taste._SEP_Bring soup to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally._SEP_Remove soup from heat and let it cool slightly._SEP_Using a blender, puree the soup in batches until very smooth._SEP_Be careful when blending hot liquids as they can splatter start on a low speed and work your way up, or puree the soup in smaller batches._SEP_Return soup to the soup pot and stir in heavy cream._SEP_If desired, add honey or sugar to balance the acidity of the tomatoes._SEP_Heat the soup on low until hot, but don't let it boil._SEP_Serve the creamy tomato soup with crusty bread or grilled cheese for a comforting and delicious meal._SEP_Enjoy!_SEP_To roast garlic: Preheat the oven to 400F._SEP_Cut off the top of a head of garlic to expose the cloves._SEP_Drizzle with olive oil and wrap in aluminum foil._SEP_Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the garlic is golden brown and soft._SEP_Let cool before using.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Apple Shortbread Pie Ingredients: 2 cups All-purpose Flour 1/4 teaspoons Salt 2 sticks Unsalted Butter, Room Temperature 1/2 cups Powdered Sugar 1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract 6 pieces Granny Smith Apples, Peeled, Cored And Cubed 4 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter 1 cup Brown Sugar 4 Tablespoons Maple Syrup 1- 1/2 teaspoon Ground Cinnamon._SEP_To prepare crust, sift the flour and salt in a large bowl._SEP_Set aside._SEP_Cream butter and powdered sugar in a bowl of a standing mixer until light and fluffy.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Rich Italian Vegetable Stew (Ratatouille My Way) Ingredients: 2 -3 zucchini, sliced 1 large eggplant, peeled and cut into chunks 1 red bell pepper, peeled and cut into chunks 1 green bell pepper, peeled and cut into chunks 1 yellow bell pepper, peeled and cut into chunk 1 large onion, chopped 2 shallots, chopped 2 large garlic cloves, chopped fine 1 (14 ounce) can diced tomatoes with juice 2 tablespoons tomato paste 1 cup chicken broth or 1 cup vegetable broth 1 teaspoon sea salt or 1 teaspoon kosher salt 1 teaspoon black pepper 1 teaspoon italian seasoning 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar._SEP_Heat a couple tablespoons of good Olive Oil in a large pot and then add the chopped onions.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Apple Refrigerator Pickles Ingredients: 1 cup water 1 cup cider vinegar 1 cup white sugar 1 tablespoon whole allspice berries 1 tablespoon whole cloves 1 tablespoon ground nutmeg 1 tablespoon ground ginger 6 apples - peeled, cored and sliced 1/2 cup lemon juice._SEP_Place the water, cider vinegar, sugar, allspice, clove, nutmeg, and ginger into a small saucepan, and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Sfratti (Nut Filled Cookies) Ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour 1 cup sugar 14 teaspoon salt 13 cup cold unsalted butter (or 1/3 cup cold margarine) 23 cup sweet wine 23 cup honey 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 14 teaspoon ground cloves 2 cups walnuts, coarsely chopped 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest 1 tablespoon grated orange zest 14 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper fine dry breadcrumb (for dusting) 1 egg yolk (beaten with 2 tablespoons water, for egg wash)._SEP_To make the dough:._SEP_In a bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and salt._SEP_Cut in the margarine or butter with a pastry blender until the mixture has the consistency of coarse meal.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Warm Flank Steak Salad with Mint and Cilantro Ingredients: 1/4 cup soy sauce 2 teaspoons freshly ground pepper 1/4 cup minced fresh lemongrass (from 2 stalks) One 2 1/2-pound flank steak 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice 2 tablespoons Asian fish sauce 1 tablespoon crushed red pepper 1/2 teaspoon sugar 2 medium shallots, thinly sliced 1/2 cup mint leaves 1/4 cup cilantro leaves 2 teaspoons roasted rice powder (optional; see Note)._SEP_In a large glass baking dish, mix the soy sauce with the pepper and 2 tablespoons of the lemongrass._SEP_Add the flank steak and turn to coat._SEP_Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Burnt Caramel Custard (Pots de Creme) Recipe Ingredients: 8 cups plus 2 tablespoons water, plus more as needed 2 cups heavy cream 3/4 cup whole milk 3/4 cup granulated sugar 6 large egg yolks 2 1/2 ounces good-quality milk chocolate, coarsely chopped._SEP_Heat the oven to 300 degrees F and arrange a rack in the middle._SEP_Bring 8 cups of the water to a simmer in a large saucepan over medium heat; keep the water at a simmer._SEP_Arrange 6 (6-ounce) ramekins 1/2 inch apart in a large roasting pan (alternatively, use 12 3-ounce espresso cups or glass candle holders); set aside.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Seared Spiced Salmon Steaks With Black Bean Salsa Ingredients: 6 (5 -6 ounce) salmon steaks (150-175g) 3 fat garlic cloves 2 teaspoons rock salt (level teaspoons) 1 12 inches piece gingerroot (4-cm) 2 limes, zest of grated, reserve the juice for the salsa 1 pinch ground cinnamon 1 pinch ground cumin 6 tablespoons chopped fresh coriander (15g) 2 tablespoons olive oil black pepper (freshly milled) 23 cup dried black beans, soaked overnight in twice their volume cold water (4oz, 110g) 3 medium ripe but firm tomatoes, skinned, de-seeded and finely chopped 1 red chile, de-seeded and finely chopped 15 g fresh coriander (1/2oz, ca 7 tbsp) 1 medium red onion, finely chopped 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil 2 limes, juice of (reserved from the salmon recipe) 12 teaspoon salt._SEP_SALSA:._SEP_To make the salsa, rinse the beans in plenty of cold water, put them in a saucepan with enough water to cover, bring to the boil and boil rapidly for 10 minutes._SEP_Then reduce the heat and simmer the beans for 30 minutes until tender._SEP_Drain and allow them to cool completely before adding all the other ingredients._SEP_Then leave them covered for several hours to allow the flavours to develop._SEP_SALMON:._SEP_A few hours before you want to cook the salmon, wipe each of the steaks with damp kitchen paper and remove any visible bones using tweezers._SEP_Place the salmon on a plate, then, with a pestle and mortar, crush the garlic cloves and rock salt together until you have a creamy puree.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Quick Pickles Ingredients: 1 cup Distilled White Vinegar 2 Tablespoons Granulated Sugar 4 Tablespoons Water 1- 1/2 teaspoon Kosher Salt 1 teaspoon Dried Dill Weed 2 cloves Garlic, Lightly Smashed 1 whole Thai Bird Chili (optional) 2 whole Bay Leaves 2 whole Cucumbers, Cut Into Thick Slices._SEP_Begin by adding the vinegar, water, sugar, salt, garlic, and chili pepper to a sauce pan and bring to a boil, stirring well to mix in the sugar._SEP_My kids cannot stand the smell of cooking vinegar, and I do it quite a bit with Asian dipping sauces, however I think they are now getting used to it!_SEP_Once boiling, remove from the heat, and add the dill weed._SEP_Let the pickling mixture completely cool._SEP_Add in the bay leaves._SEP_To a clean mason jar, add the cut cucumbers, arranging them the best you can._SEP_Pour in the cooled mixture, cover, and let sit in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours._SEP_However, overnight is probably best._SEP_When you are ready, open and serve.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Roast Loin of Venison with Savory Wine Sauce Ingredients: 1 cup olive oil 1/2 cup carrots finely chopped 1/2 cup celery finely chopped 1/2 cup onions finely chopped 4 cloves garlic minced 2 Sprigs thyme fresh 2 each bay leaves 3 pounds venison loin, boneless with bone 2 tablespoons ghee (clarified butter) 1 x salt to taste 1 x black pepper fresh 3 cups beef stock prefer veal stock if possible 2 tablespoons butter 1 x soup bones reserved from venison 1/4 cup shallots minced 1 clove garlic minced 1 sprig thyme 2 each tomatoes coarsely chopped 3 tablespoons sherry vinegar 1/4 cup port wine 2 tablespoons currant jelly 1 x salt to taste 1 x black pepper fresh, ground._SEP_Make a marinade of the first 7 ingredients._SEP_Bone the loin; trim and discard fat and sinew._SEP_With a cleaver chop the bone into 1inch pieces and reserve for the sauce._SEP_Slice loin against the grain into 6 pieces._SEP_Arrange in a single layer in a casserole dish._SEP_Pour over the marinade, cover and refrigerate 24 hours._SEP_Meanwhile prepare the sauce._SEP_Bring stock to a boil, reduce heat and cook uncovered until volume reduced by 1/2._SEP_Set aside.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Buffalo Turkey Wings Ingredients: 4 each turkey wings about 5 lbs 3/4 cups flour, all-purpose 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper 1 x vegetable oil 6 tablespoons butter melted 2 tablespoons vinegar distilled white 2 tablespoons red hot pepper sauce.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Family Favorite Lasagna Ingredients: 3 lbs ground beef 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 (6 ounce) can tomato paste 1 quart canned tomato 1 (24 ounce) carton cottage cheese 1 teaspoon oregano 8 ounces lasagna noodles, boiled 16 ounces cheddar cheese, shredded 1 tablespoon garlic powder._SEP_Brown beef and minced garlic, drain.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Our 1 Favorite Chocolate (Flourless) Cake Recipe cettlinger Ingredients: 8 ounces semi-sweet chocolate, chopped (I like Scharffen Berger, but even Hersheys works) 8 ounces bittersweet chocolate, chopped 2 sticks unsalted butter, cut into small pieces 2 T liqueur, such as triple sec, Amaretto or Kahlua (I use Kalua or a coffee liqueur) 9 large eggs, separated, the whites at room temperature 1 3/4 cups sugar._SEP_Melt the chocolate and butter in a bowl placed over a pot of boiling water, and stir until smooth._SEP_Remove the bowl and let mixture coolthen stir in the liqueur._SEP_In a large bowl beat the egg yolks with the sugar until ribbons form (about 10 minutes).

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Louisiana Boiled Shrimp (Frank Davis) Ingredients: 3 gallons water 5 ounces salt (to taste) 2 ounces cayenne pepper 2 onions, medium yellow cut in half 1 head garlic, cut in half, across 3 lemons, thinly sliced 1 cup seasoning, Frank Davis Complete Seafood Boil 20 potatoes, red, small, whole 5 ears corn, not frozen, halved 5 lbs shrimp, 26-30 count, washed, heads on 10 lbs ice._SEP_Combine and prepare ingredients._SEP_Set up a high pressure burner, propane tank, and a 40 quart/10 gallon pot._SEP_(I have an old Miller Lite Keg,16 gallons, with the top cut out, and an old Ford hub cap to cover the hole, that I use._SEP_)._SEP_Add the water to the pot and bring it to a roiling boil._SEP_When the water is ready, drop in the salt, cayenne pepper, onions, garlic, lemons, Frank's seafood boil._SEP_Boil together all the seasonings ingredients for about 15 minutes to create a rich seafood-boiling stock._SEP_Put the potatoes in the pot, let the water come back to a boil, and boil the potatoes for 10 minutes._SEP_After 10 minutes, put the corn into the pot, let the water come back to a boil, and boil them for 5 minutes.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Cranberry Pumpkin Muffins Ingredients: 2 eggs, slightly beaten 2 cups white sugar 1 cup solid pack pumpkin 1/2 cup corn oil 2 tablespoons orange zest 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour 1 tablespoon pumpkin pie spice 1 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 1/2 cups cranberries, halved._SEP_Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C)._SEP_Line 24 muffin cups with paper liners._SEP_Beat eggs, sugar, pumpkin, corn oil, and orange zest in a small mixing bowl until smooth._SEP_Mix flour, pumpkin pie spice, baking soda, and salt in a large mixing bowl with a fork._SEP_Make a well in the center of the flour mixture.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Penne With Ricotta Ingredients: 2 cups penne pasta 2 tablespoons butter 3 tablespoons parsley (fresh is possible) 12 cup ricotta cheese 1 pinch nutmeg 1 pinch cinnamon salt pepper 12 cup whipping cream 2 tablespoons olive oil 14 vegetable bouillon cube 1 small onion._SEP_Bring a pot of salted water to a boil, add the penne and cook for 10 minutes or until tender but still firm to taste._SEP_In the meantime, finely slice the onion and cook in a small pot with some olive oil or butter._SEP_Heat a 1/2 cup of water, add in the vegetable bouillon._SEP_Once the onion is properly cooked (should be tender), add everything else in, including the bouillon -- salt and pepper to taste._SEP_Stir the sauce frequently over low heat, should turn into a nice even mixture.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Oyster Sauce Recipe Ingredients: 500 g fresh oysters 4 tablespoons butter 12 small onion, finely minced 1 tablespoon finely minced fresh gingerroot 1 garlic clove, finely minced 1 teaspoon thyme 1 teaspoon oregano 1 teaspoon minced fresh basil 12 cup chicken broth 2 tablespoons flour 12 cup cream 14 cup dark soy sauce._SEP_If using fresh oysters, steamed in pan with one cup water until opened (reserve broth)_SEP_Very finely chop oysters._SEP_(If using prepackaged oysters reserve liquid)._SEP_Melt butter in a skillet and saute onion, garlic and ginger root over medium heat until onions are soft._SEP_Add minced oysters, thyme, oregano and basil._SEP_Sift in flour, mixing constantly, until flour is cooked into butter._SEP_Whisk in one cup of oyster broth or oyster liquid from prepackaged oysters, plus 1/2 cup of chicken broth, 1/2 cup cream and 1/4 cup soy sauce._SEP_Now pour sauce through a sieve, removing any solids that do not pass through the holes in the sieve.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Yellow Butter Cake with Chocolate Frosting Ingredients: 2 sticks (1 cup) unsalted butter, room temperature, plus more for pans 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for pans 1 1/2 cups cake flour (not self-rising) 1 tablespoon baking powder 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 3/4 cups sugar 4 large eggs 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract 1 1/4 cups milk Dark Chocolate Frosting (page 388)._SEP_Preheat the oven to 350F.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Breast Of Chicken With Ginger And Carrots Recipe Ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves Salt to taste, if you like Freshly grnd pepper to taste 5 carrots, sliced 2 tbsp. butter 1 tbsp. finely minced green onions 1 teaspoon ginger 1/4 c. dry white wine 1/2 c. chicken broth 3/4 c. heavy cream._SEP_Sprinkle the chicken pcs on both sides with salt and pepper._SEP_Peel and slice carrots and put into a saucepan._SEP_Add in cool water to cover and salt to taste._SEP_Bring to a boil and let cook 1 minute; drain._SEP_Heat the butter in a skillet large sufficient to hold the chicken breasts in one layer._SEP_Add in the chicken breasts and cook briefly, about 1 minute, till lightly browned on one side; don't brown well._SEP_Turn the breasts and cook till 2 min without browning._SEP_Sprinkle chicken breasts with green onions and scatter the carrots over all._SEP_Sprinkle with ginger and add in white wine and chicken broth.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Chicken Roulade Ingredients: 1 whole chicken (1.2-1.5 kg) 12 onion, diced 2 garlic cloves, minced 2 eggs, lightly beaten 1 tablespoon plain flour 3 sundry tomatoes, diced salt, pepper, grill seasoning 2 tablespoons olive oil._SEP_First you must debone the chicken.
gen_body: 1._SEP_Debone the chicken: This is the most important step in making chicken roulade._SEP_To debone the chicken, lay it on a clean cutting board, breast side down._SEP_Using a sharp knife, make a cut along one side of the backbone._SEP_Repeat on the other side of the backbone and remove it completely._SEP_Next, turn the bird over and flatten it out by pushing down with the palm of your hand._SEP_Gently remove the rib cage, being careful not to tear the skin._SEP_You should end up with a flat sheet of chicken with no bones.2._SEP_Prepare the stuffing: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat._SEP_Add the diced onions and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes._SEP_Add the minced garlic and diced sundried tomatoes and cook for another 2-3 minutes._SEP_Season the mixture with salt, pepper, and grill seasoning to taste._SEP_Remove from heat and let cool.3._SEP_Stuff the chicken: Once the stuffing mixture has cooled, spread it evenly over the chicken, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges._SEP_Roll the chicken tightly, starting from one end and working your way to the other end._SEP_Use kitchen twine to tie the roulade in several places to keep it together.4._SEP_Cook the roulade: Preheat your oven to 175C._SEP_Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat._SEP_Gently place the roulade in the skillet and brown on all sides, about 5-7 minutes in total._SEP_Transfer the skillet to the oven and cook for 45-50 minutes or until the internal temperature of the chicken reaches 74C.5._SEP_Serve the roulade: Remove the roulade from the oven and let it rest for 5-10 minutes before slicing._SEP_Remove the kitchen twine and slice the roulade into equal portions._SEP_Serve with your favourite sides and enjoy!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Duck Tamales With Mole Sauce Ingredients: 3 dried ancho chilies 2 plum tomatoes 2 fresh tomatilloes, husked 2 cloves garlic, peeled 2 cups duck or veal stock 1 teaspoon dried oregano 2 teaspoons canela or cinnamon Pinch of ground cloves 1 teaspoon ground black pepper 1/4 teaspoon ground allspice 2 ounces unsweetened chocolate, cut into small pieces Pinch of sugar 23 cup duck confit fat, chilled (see recipe) Duck confit (see recipe) 2 cups masa harina (an instant cornmeal preparation available in specialty food stores) 1 13 cups warm water Salt to taste 16 cornhusks, soaked in warm water, or cooking parchment._SEP_To make the mole sauce, cover the ancho chilies with boiling water, and allow to soak until soft._SEP_Remove the seeds, and chop the chilies._SEP_Spear the tomatoes and tomatilloes with a fork and roast over an open flame until the skins begin to blacken._SEP_Chop and place in a food processor._SEP_Roast the garlic by holding it on a fork over the flame until lightly browned._SEP_Add to the food processor, along with the duck or veal stock, chilies, oregano, canela or cinnamon, cloves, pepper and allspice._SEP_Puree this mixture._SEP_Transfer the mixture to a saucepan, and simmer 15 to 20 minutes._SEP_Add the chocolate and sugar, and stir just until melted.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Pear and Ginger Upside-Down Cake Ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter, at room temperature 12 cup butter, at room temperature 1 12 cups brown sugar, firmly packed 3 tablespoons crystallized ginger, chopped 1 lb pear (2 pears, Bosc type are recommended) 2 12 cups all-purpose flour 2 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 12 teaspoons ground ginger 1 teaspoon cinnamon 12 teaspoon salt 14 teaspoon allspice 2 large eggs 34 cup molasses 1 14 cups buttermilk._SEP_First, prepare the pan._SEP_Lightly spray a 9-inch springform pan with cooking spray, Line the pan with a 10-inch round of cooking parchment, pressing into the bottom and about 1/2 inch up the sides._SEP_Cut 2 tablespoons of butter into about 1/4-inch chunks and drop evenly over the parchment in the pan bottom._SEP_Sprinkle evenly with 1/2 cup brown sugar and the crystallized ginger._SEP_Peel the pears and cut in half, lengthwise.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Autumn Maple Cutout Cookies Ingredients: 14 cup butter 2 14 cups flour 12 teaspoon baking powder 12 teaspoon ground cinnamon 14 teaspoon baking soda 14 teaspoon salt 18 teaspoon ground nutmeg 6 tablespoons granulated sugar 12 cup maple syrup 1 teaspoon maple flavoring 2 large egg whites, divided 13 cup chopped walnuts 2 tablespoons turbinado sugar or 2 tablespoons granulated sugar cooking spray._SEP_Melt butter in a small saucepan over low heat._SEP_Cook until milk solids stop crackling and turn amber (about 5 minutes), stirring occasionally._SEP_Transfer butter mixture to a small bowl, scraping pan to include milk solids._SEP_Cover and cool butter mixture in the refrigerator for 20 minutes or until soft and congealed but not firm._SEP_Combine flour and next 5 ingredients (through nutmeg) in a bowl, stirring with a whisk._SEP_Combine chilled butter mixture and granulated sugar in a large bowl; beat at medium speed until well blended (about 3 minutes)._SEP_Add syrup, flavoring, and 1 egg white to butter mixture; beat at low speed 2 minutes or until well blended.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Boss-Worthy Chipotle Chicken Chowder Ingredients: 2 12 cups chopped onions 12 cup vegetable oil 1 large russet potato, diced into 1/4 inch cubes (baking potato, peel if you want to!) 3 -6 minced garlic cloves 1 fresh jalapeno chile, seeded and minced fine (wear rubber gloves when mincing) 12 chipotle chile, minced fine (as many as you can handle, keep the rubber gloves on to mince these!) 3 -6 tablespoons adobo sauce (but I scrape it out of the can the chipotles were in) (optional) 14 cup all-purpose flour 3 cups chicken broth 2 cups fat-free half-and-half (or regular half and half, if you can spare the calories!) 1 (15 ounce) can diced tomatoes, well-drained (or 3 - 5 fresh roma tomatoes, diced) 2 cups fresh corn (for extra smokiness, roast the corn before adding to the chowder) or 2 cups frozen corn (for extra smokiness, roast the corn before adding to the chowder) 1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley 2 diced boneless smoked chicken breasts (discard skin and fat, (or more, if you want, We smoke our own, but you can buy smoked chicken breast) salt and pepper, to taste._SEP_In a 6-quart heavy pot, cook onions in oil over moderate heat, stirring until softened._SEP_Add diced potato, garlic, and jalapeno and cook stirring, 1 minute._SEP_Stir in flour, and cook over moderately low heat, stirring about 2 minutes.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Strawberry Meringue Cake Ingredients: 1 (18 1/4 ounce) package yellow cake mix 1 13 cups orange juice 4 eggs, separated 1 12 teaspoons orange zest 14 teaspoon cream of tartar 1 cup sugar, plus 14 cup sugar, divided 2 cups whipping cream 2 pints fresh strawberries, divided._SEP_In a mixing bowl, combine cake mix, orange juice, egg yolks and orange peel._SEP_Beat on medium speed for 4 minutes._SEP_Pour into two greased and floured 9-inch round baking pans; set aside._SEP_In a mixing bowl, beat egg whites and cream of tartar on medium until foamy._SEP_Gradually beat in 1 cup sugar, a tablespoon at a time on high until stiff glossy peaks form and sugar is dissolved._SEP_Spread the meringue even over both pans of cake batter._SEP_Bake at 350F for 35 minutes or until meringue is lightly browned._SEP_Cool in pans on wire racks (meringue will crack)._SEP_Beat the cream until stiff peaks form.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Vichyssoise Soup Ingredients: 3 -5 tablespoons butter (or margarine) 3 leeks, cleaned and chopped (Important to remove the sand) 3 large potatoes, skin removed and cubed 5 cups chicken stock, heated (simmer 5 minutes if using bullion cubes or powder) 1 -2 garlic clove, chopped 1 large cucumber, skin and seed removed and cut into small pieces (add a little salt, toss and let stand for a while) 1 -2 stalk celery, cleaned and cut into small pieces 34-1 cup half-and-half cream (Substitute- Farm Fresh "Original" Brand Non-Dairy Creamer,Liquid) 12 cup instant mashed potatoes (or flour to thicken) caraway seeds or curry powder salt and white pepper chives or parsley or Mrs. Dash seasoning mix, as garnish serve with sour cream._SEP_Put potatoes in salted water and cook, until almost done._SEP_Remove potatoes, mash and then add to chicken stock._SEP_Add garlic and 2 tablespoons butter/margarine and simmer for about 5 minutes._SEP_Put potato stock through a strainer and remove any lumpy pieces._SEP_In a separate cooking pot add 1 tablespoon of butter/margarine and add the celery, stir for 1 minute and remove._SEP_In the same pot put in 2 tablespoons butter/margarine, add leeks and cook until slightly translucent._SEP_Add potato stock to leeks, stir and simmer for about 5 minutes._SEP_Add Instant mashed potatoes and stir briefly.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Country Bread Ingredients: All-purpose flour Room temperature water 3 grams fresh yeast, crumbled 1 tablespoon kosher salt._SEP_The day before making the bread or early in the day, make the poolish (or biga) by placing 8 ounces of the flour, 7 ounces of room temperature water and the yeast in a large bowl and mixing it well with a wooden spoon._SEP_Cover the bowl with a kitchen towel and let it stand for 2 to 3 hours at room temperature or in the refrigerator overnight._SEP_The poolish should double in volume._SEP_Add 1 pound of the flour and 12 ounces of room temperature water to the poolish and mix together well with your hands._SEP_It will be very sticky._SEP_Cover the bowl with the kitchen towel and let rest for 30 minutes._SEP_Sprinkle the salt over the surface of the dough and then fold the dough onto itself several times until the salt is incorporated.
