prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Smothered Pork Chops Ingredients: 12 cup all-purpose flour 14 cup coarse stone-ground cornmeal (can also use fine or medium grind) 2 teaspoons kosher salt, plus more to taste 1 12 teaspoons fresh ground black pepper, plus more to taste 12 cup whole milk 1 large egg yolk 1 12 cups peanut oil or 1 12 cups canola oil 4 bone-in center-cut pork loin chops (about 2 1/4 pounds) 1 12 cups diced yellow onions (about 1 large) 4 teaspoons all-purpose flour 1 13 cups chicken broth 23 cup whole milk or 23 cup half-and-half._SEP_Cook the pork chops: Whisk together the flour, cornmeal, salt, and black pepper in a broad, shallow bowl until thoroughly combined._SEP_Transfer to a large plate, spreading the mixture in a flat, even layer._SEP_Wipe the bowl clean with a paper towel, and pour the milk into it._SEP_Add the egg yolk and whisk until thoroughly combined._SEP_Preheat the oven to 250F, and place a heatproof platter lined with a double thickness of paper towels inside._SEP_Pour the oil into a 10-inch skillet to a depth of about 1/2 inch, and put over high heat._SEP_When the oil reaches 375F on a frying thermometer, turn the heat down to medium high._SEP_Submerge 2 of the pork chops in the bowl of egg wash until theyre completely coated, letting any excess drip back into the bowl._SEP_Press each chop firmly into the flour mixture on the plate, then flip it to coat the other side.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Kolachky Cookies Ingredients: 2 sticks margarine, softened 6 ounces cream cheese, softened 2 cups flour 1 (12-ounce can) pureed fruit filling Powdered sugar, for garnish._SEP_In a large bowl blend margarine and cream cheese together, by hand with a metal spoon._SEP_Slowly add flour until it is all incorporated and a dough is formed._SEP_The dough will be soft and sticky._SEP_Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and put in refrigerator overnight, or for several hours (until hard to the touch)._SEP_Flour the countertop._SEP_Take a handful of dough out of bowl returning the unused portion to the refrigerator (continue this process until all mixture is used).

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Mediterranean Chicken Breasts- Homemade Gourmet Ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil 3 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts 1 (8 ounce) package angel hair pasta, cooked and drained 2 cups grape tomatoes or 1 cup halved cherry tomatoes 1 garlic clove, peeled 3 tablespoons balsamic vinegar 3 tablespoons homemade gourmet garlic basil seasoning grated parmesan cheese (optional).

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Kale Salad with Spiced Cashews Ingredients: 1 bunch Kale, Stems Removed, Sliced Into Thin Strips (curly Kale Or Preferably Lacinato If You Can Find It) 1/2 cups Dried Dates, Chopped 1/2 cups Roasted, Salted Cashews 2 Tablespoons Maple Syrup 1/4 teaspoons Garam Masala 1 pinch Cayenne Pepper 3 Tablespoons Lemon Juice, Divided 2 teaspoons Pomegranate Molasses 1/2 Tablespoons Agave Nectar 1/4 cups Extra Virgin Olive Oil._SEP_Add cashews, maple syrup, garam masala and cayenne to a small nonstick pan._SEP_Cook over medium to medium-high heat, stirring frequently, for about 3-4 minutes or until mixture thickens and just coats nuts._SEP_Transfer to a baking sheet lined with a silpat or parchment paper and allow to cool._SEP_For dressing, whisk together 2 tablespoons of lemon juice, molasses and agave in a small bowl._SEP_Slowly stream in olive oil, whisking constantly._SEP_Season with salt and pepper.
gen_body: To prepare the kale, remove the tough stems and slice the leaves into thin strips._SEP_Rinse and dry the kale well, using a salad spinner if you have one._SEP_Place the kale strips in a large salad bowl._SEP_Add the chopped dates to the bowl and toss with the kale strips._SEP_The sweetness of the dates will balance the bitterness of the kale._SEP_Next, roughly chop the roasted cashews and add them to the nonstick pan with the maple syrup, garam masala and cayenne._SEP_Cook for a few minutes, stirring frequently, until the nuts are coated in the spiced maple syrup._SEP_Carefully transfer the nuts to a lined baking sheet and allow them to cool completely._SEP_While the nuts are cooling, prepare the dressing by whisking together the remaining tablespoon of lemon juice with the pomegranate molasses and agave nectar._SEP_Slowly drizzle in the olive oil while whisking constantly, until the dressing is emulsified._SEP_Season with salt and pepper to taste._SEP_Once the nuts are cool, sprinkle them over the kale and date mixture in the salad bowl._SEP_Drizzle the dressing over the top of the salad and toss everything together to coat._SEP_Your kale salad with spiced cashews is now ready to serve!_SEP_This salad makes a great lunch or light dinner, and can be paired with grilled chicken or fish for a more filling meal._SEP_The spiced cashews add a crunchy texture and savory kick to the sweet, slightly bitter kale and dates._SEP_And the tangy dressing ties it all together with a burst of flavor._SEP_Give this recipe a try and impress your friends and family with your culinary skills!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Cabbage Minestrone with Chick Peas Ingredients: 1 heaped cup chick peas, washed and picked over, soaked for 6 hours or overnight in 1 quart water 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 large onion, finely chopped 1 carrot, peeled and finely chopped 1 celery stalk, finely chopped Salt to taste 4 garlic cloves, minced 1 (28-ounce) can tomatoes, seeded and chopped, with juice 1 1/2 pounds cabbage (green or red), outer leaves removed, cored and coarsely chopped (about 1 medium cabbage) 2 1/2 quarts water A bouquet garni made with 1 Parmesan rind, a bay leaf, and a few sprigs each parsley and thyme Freshly ground pepper 1/2 cup elbow macaroni or small shells Freshly grated Parmesan for serving._SEP_Drain the chick peas and set aside._SEP_Heat the oil over medium heat in a heavy soup pot and add the onion, carrot, and celery.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Kluski Ingredients: 6 large potatoes 1 egg 1 teaspoon salt flour, Lots of it (4 to 5 lbs) 1 12 lbs bacon, cut into small pieces._SEP_Get a large kettle of salt water boiling.
gen_body: Directions: 1._SEP_Peel the potatoes and boil them until they are soft._SEP_Then, mash them thoroughly in a mixing bowl.2._SEP_Beat the egg and add it to the mashed potatoes along with the salt.3._SEP_Begin adding flour to the potato mixture._SEP_Add flour slowly, stirring in between, until the dough becomes too thick to stir.4._SEP_Flour your work surface and begin kneading the dough._SEP_Add flour when the dough gets too sticky._SEP_Knead until the dough becomes smooth.5._SEP_Divide the dough into smaller pieces and roll each piece into a thin rope, about the size of a finger.6._SEP_Cut the ropes into small pieces, about 1 inch long._SEP_Repeat with the rest of the dough until it is all cut into small pieces.7._SEP_Drop the kluski pieces into the boiling salt water, a few at a time, stirring gently so they dont stick together.8._SEP_When the kluski float to the top, remove them with a slotted spoon and place them in a colander to drain.9._SEP_In a large frying pan, fry the bacon until it is crisp._SEP_Remove the bacon to a paper towel to drain._SEP_10._SEP_Serve the kluski with the crispy bacon pieces on top._SEP_Enjoy!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Apple Cider Cured Smoked Salmon Ingredients: 1 cup brown sugar 14 cup salt 4 cups apple cider (or juice) 2 cinnamon sticks 1 teaspoon fennel seed 1 teaspoon whole allspice 1 teaspoon black peppercorns 2 bay leaves 1 teaspoon red pepper flakes 6 sprigs thyme (or 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme) 1 large salmon fillet, skin and small pin bones removed (about 1 pound each) 1 bunch wood chips (soaked)._SEP_To make brine:_SEP_In a saucepan, combine the brown sugar, salt and apple cider; bring to a boil.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Croissant Bread Pudding With Chocolate Sauce Ingredients: 6 cups lightly packed bite-size pieces croissants 6 ounces bittersweet chocolate, chopped 2 tablespoons unsalted butter 1 13 cups milk 34 cup whipping cream 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 14 teaspoon salt 3 eggs 34 cup sugar 14 teaspoon salt._SEP_Spread the croissants in a large baking pan._SEP_Dry, uncovered, at room temperature for 12 hours or heat in the oven at 250 degrees for 1 hour._SEP_Butter a shallow V/2-quart baking dish._SEP_Arrange half the croissants in a single layer in the baking dish._SEP_Sprinkle half the chocolate evenly over the croissants._SEP_Top with the remaining croissants._SEP_Whisk the eggs, sugar, milk, 1/2 cup of the cream, vanilla and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a bowl; pour over the croissants.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Saffron Shellfish Stew with Black Olive Croutons Ingredients: Four 1/2-inch-thick slices of bakery white bread, crusts removed and bread cubed 2 tablespoons black olive paste 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil Kosher salt Freshly ground black pepper 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 3 garlic cloves, chopped 1 small white onion, cut into 1/4-inch dice 3 celery ribs, cut into 1/4-inch dice 2 carrots, cut into 1/4-inch dice 1/2 teaspoon saffron threads 3 pounds mixed raw shellfish, such as scrubbed small clams and mussels, scallops and shelled and deveined shrimp 1/2 cup dry white wine 1 pint small cherry tomatoes 1 pound cooked lobster meat 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper 1 tablespoon creme fraiche Kosher salt Freshly ground black pepper Mixed chopped herbs, such as chervil, tarragon, parsley and chives, for garnish._SEP_make the croutons Preheat the oven to 325._SEP_In a medium bowl, combine the bread cubes, black olive paste and olive oil._SEP_Season with salt and black pepper and toss to coat._SEP_Transfer to a rimmed baking sheet and bake for 7 to 9 minutes, until crisp._SEP_Let the croutons cool._SEP_make the stew Heat the olive oil in a large enameled cast-iron casserole._SEP_Add the garlic, onion, celery and carrots and cook over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 15 minutes._SEP_Add the saffron and stir for 1 minute._SEP_Add the clams, wine and 1 1/2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
gen_body: Cover and simmer over low heat until the clams start to open, about 5 minutes._SEP_Add the mussels and shrimp and stir gently to combine._SEP_Cover and simmer until the clams and mussels have opened and the shrimp are pink and curled, about 5 minutes longer._SEP_Using a slotted spoon, transfer the shellfish to a large bowl; discard any that do not open._SEP_Add the cherry tomatoes and lobster meat to the casserole and simmer for 3 minutes._SEP_Stir in the red pepper and creme fraiche and season with salt and black pepper._SEP_Return the shellfish to the casserole and cook just until heated through._SEP_Serve the stew in bowls, garnished with the chopped herbs and the black olive croutons.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Pizza Dough and Sauce Ingredients: 34 tablespoon yeast 1 12 cups warm water 1 12 teaspoons salt 3 tablespoons oil 4 cups flour (we prefer half white, half wheat) 1 (6 ounce) can tomato paste 12 cup red wine or 12 cup water 1 teaspoon oregano 1 teaspoon salt 1 tablespoon sugar 1 tablespoon vegetable oil or 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 -2 tablespoon parmesan cheese._SEP_In a large bowl, sprinkle yeast over warm water (I add a pinch of sugar) and allow to set until it begins to foam, about 5 minutes._SEP_Stir in salt, oil and half of flour._SEP_Gradually add remaining flour, mixing well._SEP_Knead 8-10 minutes or until smooth and elastic._SEP_Place in greased bowl and let rise until double (1/2-1 hour) Punch down and let rise again until double._SEP_Punch down and divide._SEP_Pat out on two pizza pans._SEP_Top with pizza sauce & toppings._SEP_Bake at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes.
gen_body: To make the pizza sauce, mix tomato paste, red wine (or water), oregano, salt, sugar, and oil in a bowl until well combined._SEP_Add more or less of any ingredient to adjust the flavor to your liking._SEP_You can also add some garlic powder or red pepper flakes for some extra kick._SEP_If you prefer a thicker sauce, use less liquid._SEP_And if you like a chunkier sauce, you can add some chopped tomatoes or bell peppers._SEP_After mixing the sauce, let it sit for a few minutes to allow the flavors to blend._SEP_You can store any leftover sauce in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week._SEP_When making the pizza dough, make sure the water is warm but not too hot, or it will kill the yeast._SEP_You can use active dry yeast instead of instant yeast, but you'll need to dissolve it in warm water before adding it to the dough._SEP_Kneading the dough for 8-10 minutes is essential to develop the gluten and make the dough elastic and smooth._SEP_If you have a stand mixer with a dough hook, you can use it instead of kneading by hand._SEP_Letting the dough rise twice will make it more flavorful and airy._SEP_You can also refrigerate the dough after the first rise and use it later, up to 2-3 days._SEP_When it comes to toppings, the sky's the limit._SEP_You can use your favorite cheese, meat, and vegetables, or try some unconventional ones, like pineapple or figs._SEP_To prevent the toppings from sliding off, use a little less sauce and cheese, and distribute them evenly._SEP_Pre-baking the crust for a few minutes before adding the toppings can also help._SEP_Baking the pizza at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes is a good starting point, but the time may vary depending on your oven and the thickness of the crust._SEP_Keep an eye on the pizza and take it out when the cheese is melted and bubbly, and the crust is golden brown._SEP_Enjoy your homemade pizza with a salad or some garlic bread, and don't forget to share with your loved ones!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Mustard-Baked Eggs Ingredients: 12 ounce grated parmesan cheese (2 tablespoons) 2 tablespoons light cream or 2 tablespoons heavy cream 2 teaspoons Dijon mustard salt, to taste (use sparingly) black pepper, to taste 4 eggs._SEP_Preheat oven to 350._SEP_Lightly butter or oil two 4" ovenproof ramekins or bowls._SEP_Mix together the cheese, cream, mustard, salt, and pepper.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Cardinal Favorite Ingredients: 1 pomegranate 14 teaspoon sugar._SEP_Cut the pomegranate in half crosswise._SEP_Sprinkle each half with sugar.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Nuns Puffs Ingredients: 1/2 cups Butter 1 cup Milk 3/4 cups All-purpose Flour 4 whole Eggs 1 Tablespoon Sugar Honey, To Serve (optional)._SEP_Preheat oven to 375 degrees._SEP_Generously grease twelve 2 1/2-inch muffin cups including the edges and around the top of each cup._SEP_Set aside._SEP_Melt butter in a saucepan and add milk._SEP_Bring to a boil and then add flour all at once, stirring vigorously._SEP_Cook and stir until mixture forms a ball that does not separate._SEP_Remove from heat and let cool for 5 minutes (I put it into a bowl so it cools better).

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Chicken Waterzooi Ingredients: 2 large carrots 2 medium onions 2 tender ribs of celery 2 medium-sized leeks, white and tender green parts only 1/2 teaspoon dried tarragon Salt and freshly ground white pepper to taste 2 1/2 pounds cut-up frying chicken, legs or thighs or breasts (with bone), or a mixture of these 1 1/2 cups dry white French vermouth 1 1/2 to 2 cups chicken broth 1/2 cup heavy cream 1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch 6 egg yolks 3 tablespoons minced fresh parsley._SEP_Trim and wash the vegetables and cut them into julienne matchsticks one and three-quarters inches long and one-eighth inch wide._SEP_(This should come to about five cups in all.)_SEP_Toss them in a large mixing bowl with the tarragon and a sprinkling of salt and pepper._SEP_Wash and dry the chicken pieces and set aside._SEP_Using a casserole large enough to hold the chicken and the vegetables comfortably, layer in the following order: one-third of the vegetables, half of the chicken, half of the remaining vegetables, the rest of the chicken and the remaining vegetables._SEP_Pour in the vermouth and enough chicken broth to barely cover the chicken._SEP_Up to this point, the recipe may be prepared several hours in advance._SEP_Cover and refrigerate.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Pumpkin Pie Ingredients: 1 cup cooked and pureed pumpkin, drained in a fine strainer 3/4 cup creme fraiche Generous 1/3 cup brown sugar, firmly packed 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger Pinch ground cloves 2 large eggs, lightly beaten 1 teaspoon vanilla 2 tablespoons brandy or dark rum 1 (10-inch) prebaked pie shell, recipe follows._SEP_Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F._SEP_In a large mixing bowl, combine the pureed pumpkin, creme fraiche, brown sugar, salt, cinnamon, ginger, and cloves and whisk together until thoroughly blended._SEP_Stir in the eggs, vanilla, and brandy or rum._SEP_Whisk again until thoroughly blended._SEP_Mound the pumpkin mixture into the pie shell and jiggle the pan gently to help it find its level.
gen_body: Bake the pie for 1 hour or until the filling is just set, with a slight wobble in the center._SEP_Cool the pie to room temperature on a wire rack before serving._SEP_Serve with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream, if desired._SEP_To make the pie shell: Ingredients: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon sugar 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, chilled and cut into small pieces 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening, chilled 3 to 4 tablespoons ice water In a medium mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and sugar._SEP_Using a pastry cutter or your fingertips, cut in the butter and shortening until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs._SEP_Drizzle in the ice water, 1 tablespoon at a time, tossing the mixture with your fingers until it forms a ball._SEP_Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and chill it in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before rolling it out on a lightly floured surface._SEP_Transfer the dough to a 10-inch pie pan and trim the edges._SEP_Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F and bake the pie shell for 15 to 20 minutes, until lightly golden._SEP_Allow the pie shell to cool before adding the pumpkin filling.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Buttermilk Cornbread with Monterey Jack Cheese Ingredients: 1 cup all purpose flour 1 cup yellow cornmeal 2 teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup (packed) coarsely grated Monterey Jack cheese 3/4 cup buttermilk 2 large eggs 3 tablespoons honey 1/4 cup (1/2 stick) unsalted butter, melted._SEP_Preheat oven to 425F._SEP_Butter 8x8x2-inch metal baking pan._SEP_Whisk first 5 ingredients in medium bowl to blend._SEP_Stir in cheese._SEP_Whisk buttermilk, eggs, and honey in another medium bowl to blend._SEP_Add butter; whisk until blended.
gen_body: Add buttermilk mixture to dry ingredients and stir just until blended._SEP_Do not overmix._SEP_Pour batter into prepared pan._SEP_Smooth top with spatula._SEP_Bake until top is golden brown and toothpick inserted into center comes out clean, about 20-25 minutes._SEP_Let cornbread cool in pan for 5 minutes before serving._SEP_Cut into squares and serve warm with butter, honey, or your favorite toppings._SEP_Tips: - Make sure your ingredients are at room temperature before starting._SEP_- If you don't have buttermilk, you can make your own by adding 1 tablespoon of vinegar or lemon juice to a measuring cup, then filling it up to the 3/4 cup mark with milk._SEP_Let it sit for a few minutes until it curdles._SEP_- If you prefer a sweeter cornbread, you can increase the amount of honey to your liking._SEP_- For a spicier version, add chopped jalapeno peppers or red pepper flakes to the batter._SEP_- This cornbread is perfect as a side dish for chili, BBQ, or fried chicken._SEP_- Leftovers can be stored in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days._SEP_You can also freeze it for longer storage._SEP_Just wrap it tightly in plastic wrap, then in aluminum foil, and label it with the date._SEP_It will keep for up to 3 months in the freezer._SEP_To reheat, thaw it in the fridge overnight, then heat it up in the oven or microwave.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Cheesy Eggplant (Aubergine) Marinara Ingredients: 8 slices eggplants (center-cut about 1/2-inch thick) 1 12 cups flour seasoning salt (or white salt) pepper 3 eggs, well beaten 1 cup grated parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh breadcrumbs 4 -6 tablespoons olive oil 1 12 cups ricotta cheese (you can use less) 2 cups favorite marinara sauce (I use my Kittencal's Marinara Pasta Sauce (Vegetarian) for this) 1 12 cups mozzarella cheese.
gen_body: Instructions: 1._SEP_Preheat your oven to 400F (200C).2._SEP_Mix the flour, seasoning salt, and pepper in a shallow bowl.3._SEP_In another shallow bowl, beat the eggs.4._SEP_In a third shallow bowl, mix the grated parmesan cheese and fresh breadcrumbs.5._SEP_Dip each eggplant slice in the flour mixture, then the beaten eggs, and finally the breadcrumb mixture.6._SEP_Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat._SEP_Cook the eggplant slices until they are golden brown on both sides._SEP_You may have to do this in batches.7._SEP_Spread a thin layer of marinara sauce in a 9x13 inch baking dish.8._SEP_Arrange half of the cooked eggplant slices over the marinara sauce in the baking dish.9._SEP_Spread the ricotta cheese over the eggplant slices._SEP_10._SEP_Spoon more marinara sauce over the ricotta._SEP_11._SEP_Arrange the remaining eggplant slices over the marinara sauce._SEP_12._SEP_Spoon the remaining marinara sauce over the eggplant slices._SEP_13._SEP_Sprinkle the mozzarella cheese over the top of the dish._SEP_14._SEP_Cover the dish with foil and bake in the preheated oven for 25 minutes._SEP_15._SEP_Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes until the cheese is melted and bubbly._SEP_16._SEP_Let the dish cool for a few minutes before serving._SEP_Enjoy your delicious cheesy eggplant (aubergine) marinara!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Mamas Cilantro and Lime Chicken Ingredients: 1/4 cups Fresh Lime Juice 1/2 cups Fresh Cilantro 4 cloves Garlic Chooped 1 Tablespoon Honey 1 Tablespoon Olive Oil 1 teaspoon Salt 1 teaspoon Pepper 4 whole Chicken Breasts._SEP_Add ingredients (except chicken) to a large bowl and stir them all together._SEP_It doesnt matter what order, just dump them in there.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Red Rooibos Chai (Western Cape, Africa) Ingredients: 1 12 teaspoons whole cloves 2 teaspoons fresh cardamom pods, crushed (or 1 tsp ground cardamom) 7 -9 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger 12 bay leaf 1 teaspoon fennel 1 teaspoon peppercorn 1 stick cinnamon 12 cup red rooibos tea leaves 14 cup honey ((4 tbsp or 4 oz-start with 1 tbsp honey and add more to taste) 2 cups milk (I use almond, soy, or rice milk)._SEP_Steep(marinate) spices in 8 oz(1 cup) boiling water that's been taken off the heat._SEP_Marinate overnight in fridge._SEP_Strain out spices from marinade.
gen_body: 1._SEP_In a small saucepan, place 1 1/2 teaspoons whole cloves, 2 teaspoons fresh cardamom pods or 1 teaspoon ground cardamom, 7-9 tablespoons chopped fresh ginger, 1 bay leaf, 1 teaspoon fennel, 1 teaspoon peppercorn, and 1 stick cinnamon.2._SEP_Add 8 oz (1 cup) boiling water that has been taken off the heat, to the spices._SEP_Allow the spices to steep (marinate) overnight in the fridge.3._SEP_After marinating, strain out the spices using a fine mesh strainer.4._SEP_In a separate saucepan, heat 2 cups of milk until almost boiling.5._SEP_Add 1/2 cup of red rooibos tea leaves and the spice marinade to the heated milk.6._SEP_Reduce the heat and let the mixture simmer on low for 10 minutes.7._SEP_Strain the mixture through a fine mesh strainer to remove any tea leaves or spices.8._SEP_Add honey to the chai a tablespoon at a time, until desired sweetness is reached.9._SEP_Enjoy your homemade red rooibos chai!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Omelets Ingredients: 2 teaspoons Canola Oil 13 whole Red Or Green Pepper, Stem And Seeds Removed, Then Chopped 1/4 whole Onion, Chopped 1 pinch Salt And Pepper, to taste 1/4 teaspoons Italian Seasoning 4 whole Eggs (4 Eggs Should Yield About 3/4 Cup) 1/4 cups 2% Milk 1 pinch Pepper 1/2 teaspoons Canola Oil 1/2 cups Shredded Cheddar Cheese 4 ounces, weight Deli Ham, Chopped 1/4 cups Salsa (optional) 1 whole Roma Tomato, Chopped, Optional._SEP_For the vegetable filling: In a skillet over medium heat, heat the oil._SEP_Add pepper, onion, salt, pepper and Italian seasoning and saute until vegetables are just beginning to soften, about 4 minutes._SEP_Remove from heat._SEP_In a small bowl, beat the 4 eggs with 1/4 cup milk.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Marty's Creamy Pineapple Sorbet Ingredients: 1 12 cups pineapple chunks 13 cup fat free artificially sweetened pina colada yogurt, coconut yogurt or 13 cup vanilla yogurt 1 teaspoon lemon juice, preferably fresh squeezed 1 -2 teaspoon sugar substitute, to taste (opt, 1-2 packets).

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Spring Minestrone With Chicken Meatballs Ingredients: 6 ounces ground chicken (about 3/4 cup) 12 cup fresh breadcrumb 6 tablespoons finely grated parmesan cheese, divided, plus more for garnish 4 garlic cloves, 2 minced, 2 thinly sliced 2 tablespoons fresh chives, chopped 1 large egg, whisked to blend kosher salt, freshly ground pepper 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 1 leek, white and pale-green parts only, sliced into 1/4-inch rounds 5 cups low sodium chicken broth 34 cup ditalini or 34 cup other small shell pasta 1 cup peeled carrot, cut in 1/2-inch rounds 1 cup packed Baby Spinach fresh basil, chopped._SEP_Mix chicken, breadcrumbs, 3 tablespoons Parmesan, 2 minced garlic cloves, chives, egg, 3/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper in a medium bowl.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Spinach Banana Smoothie Ingredients: 4 cups Baby Spinach, RAW 6 ounces vanilla yogurt, 1 serving 1 banana water._SEP_Place 4 cups of spinach into a blender._SEP_Pour yogurt over the spinach._SEP_Slice the banana and put that into the blender, too._SEP_Blend for about 1-2 minutes.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Speedy Chili Ingredients: 1 lb hamburger 1 onion, chopped 1 (12 ounce) can tomato soup, undiluted 1 (15 ounce) can kidney beans, do not drain 1 (15 ounce) can stewed tomatoes 2 teaspoons chili powder salt & pepper Fritos corn chips shredded cheddar cheese shredded lettuce._SEP_In a large skillet, brown meat and chopped onion._SEP_Drain Add tomato soup, kidney beans, stewed tomatoes and chili powder._SEP_Salt& pepper to taste.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Bubble-Up Taco Bake Ingredients: 1 lb ground beef 1 medium onion, chopped 4 tablespoons taco seasoning, divided 14 cup water 1 cup salsa 1 (15 ounce) can black beans 1 (16 1/3 ounce) can refrigerated biscuits 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon dried basil leaves 12 teaspoon onion powder 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese._SEP_In a medium skillet, brown hamburger and chopped onion._SEP_While the meat is cooking, combine 2 T of the taco seasoning, onion powder, garlic powder and basil in a 1 quart plastic storage bag._SEP_Shake to mix well._SEP_Cut the biscuits into quarters.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Meyer Lemon Vinaigrette Ingredients: 2 12 meyer lemons (juiced for a total of 1/2 cup fresh Meyer Lemon juice) 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar 2 garlic cloves 1 tablespoon prepared whole grain mustard 1 tablespoon dried Italian herb seasoning 2 tablespoons honey 1 tablespoon granulated sugar or 1 tablespoon sugar substitute 1 pinch salt 1 12 cups extra virgin olive oil._SEP_Combine all ingredients except oil in a blender._SEP_Pulse a few times to chop garlic thoroughly and mix ingredients together._SEP_On low speed, slowly add olive oil to mixture in a steady stream._SEP_Add oil until mixture has emulsified to a vinaigrette.
gen_body: Taste the vinaigrette and add salt or more sugar as needed._SEP_Pour the mixture into a glass jar and refrigerate for at least thirty minutes before serving._SEP_The flavor of this Meyer Lemon Vinaigrette is tangy and bright, with a slight sweetness from the honey._SEP_It is excellent on crisp green salads, roasted vegetables, grilled meat, or fish._SEP_The red wine vinegar provides a more robust flavor, balancing the sweetness of the Meyer lemons._SEP_If you cannot find Meyer lemons, regular lemons can also be used, although they will not have the same sweet citrus flavor as the Meyer lemons._SEP_To juice the Meyer lemons, cut them in half and use a citrus juicer or squeeze the lemons by hand into a measuring cup._SEP_Using whole grain mustard instead of a smooth mustard provides a bit of texture to the vinaigrette, which is particularly lovely on salads with crunchy greens._SEP_Dried Italian herb seasoning blends typically include basil, oregano, rosemary, thyme, and marjoram, but you can substitute with any herbs you have on hand._SEP_Finally, be sure to use high-quality extra virgin olive oil as it will affect the overall flavor of the vinaigrette._SEP_Overall, this Meyer Lemon Vinaigrette recipe is an easy way to add a zesty kick to any dish and is perfect for those who love a sweet and savory combination.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Parsnip and Pear Latkes Ingredients: 1 6- to 7-ounce underripe Bosc pear, quartered, cored 1 7- to 8-ounce parsnip, peeled, cut into 1-inch pieces 1 large egg, beaten to blend 1 1/2 tablespoons chopped celery leaves 1 1/2 teaspoons drained white horseradish 3/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup panko (Japanese breadcrumbs) Vegetable oil (for frying)._SEP_Using coarse grating blade, shred pear in processor._SEP_Transfer to paper towels; squeeze very dry._SEP_Transfer to large bowl.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Orange Cake Ingredients: 2 12 cups self-rising flour or 2 12 cups cake flour 1 cup instant Tang orange drink 1 14 cups orange juice 2 cups sugar 2 eggs 12 teaspoon orange 12 teaspoon vanilla extract 12 cup oil or 12 cup softened butter or 12 cup margarine 14 cup sour cream._SEP_Preheat oven to 350._SEP_In a large bowl, mix flour and sugar manually._SEP_Add powder and orange juice to the mixture._SEP_Using an electric blender, mix at low speed; fold in sour cream and oil.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Polenta With Hot Tomato-Eggplant Sauce Ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds eggplant 2 tablespoons olive oil 2 cloves garlic 18 teaspoon hot-pepper flakes 2 cups canned no-salt-added tomatoes 1 teaspoon balsamic vinegar 6 tablespoons instant or finely ground polenta 1/4 teaspoon salt Freshly ground black pepper to taste 2 ounces Fontina cheese 2 slices coarse Italian bread._SEP_If using a broiler, turn on._SEP_Wash, trim and slice eggplant lengthwise into 1/4-inch-thick pieces._SEP_Brush with four teaspoons of the oil._SEP_If using a top-of-the-stove grill, prepare._SEP_Broil or grill the eggplant until it begins to brown on both sides._SEP_Set aside._SEP_Mince garlic, and saute in the remaining two teaspoons of hot oil in a saucepan with hot-pepper flakes for 30 seconds._SEP_Crush tomatoes with your fingers and add them in the pan with vinegar.
gen_body: Season the sauce with salt and pepper and let it simmer, uncovered for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally._SEP_Cut Fontina cheese into short strips._SEP_In a medium saucepan, bring four cups of water to a boil._SEP_Reduce heat to medium-low and add polenta, stirring constantly with a wooden spoon for three to four minutes, or until thickened._SEP_Season polenta with salt and pepper to taste._SEP_To assemble, spoon polenta on plates and arrange eggplant slices on top._SEP_Pour hot tomato sauce over eggplant and then sprinkle Fontina strips over the sauce._SEP_Place bread under the broiler and toast until lightly crisp, then serve alongside the polenta._SEP_Enjoy your delicious polenta with hot tomato-eggplant sauce!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Florentines Ingredients: 60g butter 1/4 cup caster sugar 1/4 cup honey 2 1/2 cups corn flakes, lightly crushed 125g packet (1 cup) flaked almonds, toasted 3/4 cup sultanas 100g packet (1/2 cup) red glace cherries, roughly chopped 1/3 cup flour 200g TOBLERONE* Milk or Dark Chocolate, melted.
gen_body: Instructions: 1._SEP_Preheat your oven to 160C (fan-forced)._SEP_Line baking trays with baking paper.2._SEP_In a medium saucepan, melt the butter, sugar, and honey over medium heat._SEP_Stir until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is smooth.3._SEP_Remove the saucepan from heat and stir in the cornflakes, toasted almonds, sultanas, chopped glace cherries, and flour.4._SEP_Using a tablespoon, drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto the lined baking trays, leaving space for them to spread.5._SEP_Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until golden brown._SEP_Allow the Florentines to cool on the trays for 5 minutes before transferring them to wire racks to cool completely.6._SEP_Once the Florentines have cooled, melt the TOBLERONE* chocolate in a heatproof bowl over a pot of simmering water._SEP_Stir occasionally until smooth.7._SEP_Drizzle the melted chocolate over the Florentines, using a fork or a piping bag._SEP_Allow the chocolate to set before serving.8._SEP_Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week._SEP_Enjoy your homemade Florentines!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Layered Fudge Bars - Chocolate Fudge and Nut Squares Ingredients: 1 cup (225 ml) shortening (I use half butter flavored Crisco and half real unsalted butter) 2 cups (475 ml) brown sugar 2 eggs (I use Jumbo eggs, large or x-large are fine) 3 tsp (15 ml) vanilla 1-1/2 cups (350 ml) flour 1 tsp (5 ml) baking soda 1-1/2 tsp (7 ml) salt 4 cups (950 ml) quick cooking oats 2 cups (475 ml) chopped nuts 2 tbsp (30 ml) butter 12 ounces chocolate chips 1 can (14 ounces) sweetened condensed milk._SEP_Cream the shortening (and butter if you use it) until fluffy; add sugar and beat thoroughly._SEP_Add eggs and 1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla; beat well._SEP_Sift flour, baking soda, and 1 tsp (5 ml) of salt; add to mixture and mix well.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Matzo Farfel Apple Kugel Ingredients: 2 cups matzo farfel 2 eggs 2 egg whites 14 cup sugar 1 teaspoon salt 5 tablespoons margarine, separated 12 cup water 2 apples, peeled, cored and sliced 1 teaspoon lemon juice 14 cup ground walnuts._SEP_Preheat the oven to 350degF.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Jerusalem Artichoke Relish Ingredients: 6 lbs jerusalem artichokes 3 lbs white cabbage, cored and roughly chopped 1 12 lbs white onions, peeled and roughly chopped 3 green bell peppers, cored and roughly chopped 3 red bell peppers, cored and roughly chopped 2 cups pickling salt (not iodized) 4 tablespoons white vinegar 12 cup flour one 24 ounce jar french's yellow mustard 1 quart apple cider vinegar 1 quart white wine vinegar 3 lbs sugar 3 tablespoons mustard seeds 2 tablespoons celery seeds 1 tablespoon turmeric 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper 1 teaspoon ground allspice 1 teaspoon ground cloves 1 teaspoon ground black pepper._SEP_You will need 2 large stainless steel pots or very large plastic bowls to soak the vegetables._SEP_They must be large enough to hold one gallon of water each, plus 6 pounds of vegetables (chopped) each._SEP_DO NOT use aluminum; the vinegar will react with it._SEP_First you have to clean the artichokes._SEP_They are pretty knobby, and they collect a lot of dirt and grit._SEP_Put the artichokes in a large pot and cover with water._SEP_Scrub each artichoke thoroughly with a stiff vegetable brush, and run it under some water._SEP_If grit seems to be trapped between the artichoke and its "fingers", you may have to pop them off to get the grit out._SEP_Make a brine out of ONE of the cups of salt, one gallon of water, and the 4 tablespoons of white vinegar.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Raspberry Chocolate Trifle Ingredients: 1 (18 ounce) package chocolate cake mix 2 (8 ounce) packagesnestle chocolate raspberry mousse mix 1 (8 ounce) jar raspberry preserves, stirred until smooth 2 (16 ounce) packages frozen raspberries 12-1 cup light corn syrup puree frozen raspberries, strain to remove seeds, Add corn syrup, to desired sweetness._SEP_make cake according to pkg._SEP_directions._SEP_bake in 2 round pans._SEP_slice cooled cakes into 4 layers.
gen_body: Prepare the chocolate raspberry mousse mix by following the instructions on the package._SEP_Once ready, set aside to cool._SEP_In a trifle bowl, place a layer of cake at the bottom._SEP_Use a pastry brush to brush a generous amount of raspberry preserves on top of the cake layer, to create a spread._SEP_Then, add a layer of the chocolate raspberry mousse._SEP_Repeat these layers until you've used up all the cake, preserves, and mousse._SEP_Finish off the top layer with a generous amount of the raspberry puree that we made earlier._SEP_Add some fresh raspberries on top of the puree to give it a beautiful, colorful appearance._SEP_The raspberry puree will seep into the layers of the cake and create a deliciously moist texture._SEP_Refrigerate the trifle for at least an hour before serving._SEP_This recipe is perfect for summer barbecues, gatherings, and potlucks._SEP_It's easy to make, but your guests will be impressed with how beautiful it looks and tastes._SEP_The combination of the rich chocolate cake, creamy raspberry mousse, tart raspberry puree, and sweet preserves create a perfect balance of flavors that will leave your guests craving more._SEP_Pick up the ingredients today and make your very own raspberry chocolate trifle!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Chocolate Strawberry Shortcake Ingredients: 2 pints strawberries, hulled and cut in half (reserve 4 or 5 whole berries to dip in chocolate as a garnish, if desired) 2 tablespoons sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 devil's food cake mix, prepared and baked into two 9 inch layers 1 (8 ounce) container Cool Whip, thawed 3 ounces semisweet chocolate 3 tablespoons water 1 tablespoon butter 1 cup powdered sugar 12 teaspoon vanilla._SEP_Prepare chocolate glaze: Microwave chocolate, water and butter in a large bowl on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until chocolate is melted.
gen_body: Stir in powdered sugar and vanilla until well combined.1._SEP_Preheat your oven to 350F (175C).2._SEP_In a large bowl, toss together the strawberries, sugar, and vanilla._SEP_Set aside.3._SEP_Prepare the cake mix according to the directions on the package, and bake two 9-inch rounds.4._SEP_Allow the cake to cool completely on a wire rack.5._SEP_Once cooled, spread a layer of Cool Whip on top of one of the cake rounds.6._SEP_Spoon the strawberry mixture over the Cool Whip layer.7._SEP_Place the second cake round over the strawberries and spread another layer of Cool Whip over the entire cake.8._SEP_Melt the 3 ounces of chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl in the microwave, stirring every 30 seconds until melted and smooth.9._SEP_Add the powdered sugar and vanilla to the melted chocolate and mix well._SEP_10._SEP_Let the chocolate mixture cool for a couple of minutes before spreading it evenly over the top of the cake._SEP_11._SEP_Garnish with the reserved whole strawberries, if desired._SEP_12._SEP_Chill the cake for at least 30 minutes before serving to allow the layers to set._SEP_Enjoy your delicious chocolate strawberry shortcake!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Fried Yuca Turnovers with Black Beans and Chorizo Ingredients: 2 cups mayonnaise 1/2 cup finely chopped cilantro 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice 1 small jalapeno, minced 1 garlic clove, minced 1/4 cup warm water Salt and freshly ground pepper 2 pounds fresh yuca, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks, or 1 1/2 pounds frozen yuca 2 cups cooked black beans, rinsed and drained if canned 2 cups grated Mexican Cotija, Nicaraguan Chontaleno or Pecorino Romano cheese (1/2 pound) 4 ounces Spanish chorizo, casing removed, sausage finely chopped 2 medium onions, finely chopped 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper Salt 1 teaspoon frehsly ground black pepper Peanut oil, for frying._SEP_combine the mayonnaise, cilantro, lime juice, jalapeno and garlic in a blender._SEP_Add the water and blend until smooth.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Chicken Stew Ingredients: 2 -3 lbs skinless chicken breasts 8 baby carrots, chopped (pre-peeled) 1 stalk celery, chopped 12 small onion, chopped 1 bay leaf 28 ounces crushed tomatoes or 28 ounces diced tomatoes 2 garlic cloves, minced 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 8 ounces pasta (cooked 1 min. prior to al dente) or 8 ounces red kidney beans (1 can) 3 tablespoons olive oil (depending) 1 (14 ounce) can chicken broth (to desired consistency) or 2 (14 ounce) cans chicken broth (to desired consistency) salt & pepper.
gen_body: Instructions: 1._SEP_Cut the chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces and set them aside.2._SEP_In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat._SEP_Add the chopped onions, celery, and baby carrots.3._SEP_Cook until the vegetables are tender and the onions are translucent, about 5-7 minutes.4._SEP_Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.5._SEP_Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.6._SEP_Pour in the canned tomatoes and chicken broth._SEP_Add a bay leaf and season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.7._SEP_Bring the stew to a simmer and cook for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.8._SEP_Add the cooked pasta or canned kidney beans to the stew and warm through.9._SEP_If the stew is too thick, add more chicken broth to achieve the desired consistency._SEP_10._SEP_Remove the bay leaf before serving._SEP_Enjoy!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Johnny Marzetti Ingredients: 1 lb ground beef 1 large yellow onion, peeled & chopped 8 ounces sliced mushrooms 2 cups canned tomato sauce 2 tablespoons brown sugar 1 tablespoon salt 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese, shredded 13 ounces elbow macaroni, uncooked._SEP_Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
gen_body: 1._SEP_In a large skillet, brown the ground beef over medium-high heat until fully cooked._SEP_Drain any excess fat from the skillet.2._SEP_Add the chopped onion and sliced mushrooms to the skillet with the cooked ground beef._SEP_Saut until the onions and mushrooms are soft and tender.3._SEP_Pour in the canned tomato sauce, brown sugar, and salt._SEP_Mix well to combine all ingredients.4._SEP_Allow the mixture to simmer over low heat for about 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.5._SEP_While the meat sauce is simmering, cook the elbow macaroni according to package directions until al dente.6._SEP_Once the macaroni is cooked, drain it in a colander and rinse it with cold water to stop the cooking process.7._SEP_In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, layer half of the cooked macaroni on the bottom of the dish.8._SEP_Pour half of the meat sauce over the macaroni.9._SEP_Sprinkle half of the shredded cheddar cheese on top of the meat sauce._SEP_10._SEP_Repeat with the remaining macaroni, meat sauce, and cheese._SEP_11._SEP_Cover the baking dish with foil and bake for 25 to 30 minutes._SEP_12._SEP_Remove the foil and bake for an additional 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly._SEP_13._SEP_Serve hot and enjoy!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Jack's Sliders Ingredients: 1 pound ground beef 1 pound ground sausage 1/2 cup finely chopped onion 1/4 cup minced garlic 2 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley, plus more for garnish 1 egg 1/2 cup grated Parmesan, plus more for garnish 1 cup panko breadcrumbs 12 ounces ricotta cheese 2 tablespoons kosher salt Olive oil 4 cups red sauce, heated Small potato buns (slider size), toasted._SEP_Preheat the oven to 450 degrees._SEP_Mix the beef, sausage, onions, garlic, thyme, parsley, egg, Parmesan, breadcrumbs, ricotta and salt in a bowl together with your hands (like mixing play dough)._SEP_Form 1 1/2-inch inch balls out of the meat mixture._SEP_Heat a large ovenproof skillet (preferably cast iron) with a bit of olive oil._SEP_Add the meatballs and brown on all sides, about 3 minutes._SEP_Place the skillet in the oven to finish cooking, 5 to 7 minutes.
gen_body: Take out the skillet and carefully remove the meatballs with a slotted spoon._SEP_In the same skillet, pour the red sauce and bring to a simmer._SEP_Add the meatballs back in and spoon the sauce over them._SEP_On a separate skillet, toast the potato buns until they are golden brown._SEP_Place the meatballs on the bottom half of each bun and top with a sprinkle of Parmesan and chopped parsley._SEP_Cover with the top of the bun and secure with a toothpick._SEP_Serve while hot._SEP_Jack's sliders are the perfect party food or appetizer for a family gathering._SEP_The combination of ground beef and sausage creates a juicy and flavorful ball with an added crunch from the breadcrumbs._SEP_The ricotta cheese adds a creamy texture and the herbs add a hint of freshness._SEP_The red sauce ties everything together with its tangy and sweet flavor._SEP_When shaping the meatballs, it's important not to overwork the mixture._SEP_Just mix until everything is incorporated, otherwise, the meatballs can become tough._SEP_Cooking the meatballs first on the skillet creates a crispy crust and finishing them in the oven ensures a perfectly cooked center._SEP_To make these sliders even more special, guests can choose their own toppings._SEP_Some ideas include sliced tomatoes, lettuce, pickles, or even bacon._SEP_For a healthier option, the sliders can also be served on top of a bed of greens instead of a bun._SEP_These sliders can be made ahead of time and reheated in the oven._SEP_They also freeze well and can be reheated in the oven straight from the freezer._SEP_With their delicious flavor and versatility, Jack's sliders are sure to become a favorite in any household.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Christmas Party Drink Ingredients: 200 ml White wine 100 ml Water 5 grams Gelatin powder 20 ml Water (to bloom the gelatin) 20 grams Sugar 1 tsp Honey 1 Berries 1 Mint or chervil for decoration 1 Chilled champagne or carbonated water._SEP_Dissolve the gelatin in water._SEP_Add the sugar and honey into a saucepan along with the white wine._SEP_Bring the mixture to a boil and boil off the alcohol._SEP_Turn off the heat, add the dissolved gelatin and stir well._SEP_Put the mixture in a tray or container and leave to set in the fridge._SEP_Mash the mixture up with a fork to create the crushed jello and add it to some glasses along with your preferred type of berry._SEP_Keep the glasses chilled in the refrigerator until just before your guests arrive._SEP_Fill the glass with champagne or carbonated water to serve._SEP_You could also add the mixture into some small cups and enjoy them as a jello-like dessert.
gen_body: 1._SEP_Dissolve the gelatin powder in 20 ml water in a bowl and set aside.2._SEP_In a saucepan, combine the white wine, 100 ml water, sugar, and honey._SEP_Bring to a boil over high heat.3._SEP_Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, until the sugar has dissolved and the alcohol has boiled off.4._SEP_Remove from heat and add the dissolved gelatin._SEP_Stir until completely combined.5._SEP_Pour the mixture into a tray or container and refrigerate until set._SEP_This will take approximately 2-4 hours.6._SEP_Once the mixture is set, use a fork to mash it into small pieces._SEP_Add a spoonful of the crushed jello to glasses or cups.7._SEP_Add berries to the cups or glasses.8._SEP_Just before serving, fill the glass with chilled champagne or carbonated water.9._SEP_Garnish with mint or chervil and serve immediately._SEP_Enjoy your festive Christmas party drink!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Crispy Cheddar Crackers Ingredients: 1/2 cups All-purpose Flour 1/2 cups Whole Wheat Flour 1/2 teaspoons Black Pepper 1/2 teaspoons Red Pepper 1/2 teaspoons Salt 4 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter, Cold And Cut Into Cubes 8 ounces, weight Sharp Cheddar, Freshly Grated 3- 1/2 Tablespoons Water Additional Salt For Sprinkling._SEP_Combine flours, peppers, and salt in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the blade attachment._SEP_Pulse a few times to mix well._SEP_Add butter and pulse until mixture resembles a coarse meal._SEP_Add grated cheese about 1/2 cup at a time, pulsing 4-5 times after each addition._SEP_Add water, 1 tablespoon at a time, and pulse between each addition until the majority of the mixture forms into a ball of dough._SEP_Remove dough from food processor and press any remaining bits into the dough to form a single ball.
gen_body: Divide the dough in half and shape each half into a disk._SEP_Wrap each disk in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 3 days._SEP_When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 375F (190C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper._SEP_Take one of the disks of dough out of the refrigerator and roll it out on a floured surface until it is about 1/8 inch thick._SEP_Use a small cookie cutter or a knife to cut the dough into small shapes, such as squares or circles._SEP_Repeat with the second disk of dough._SEP_Place the crackers on the prepared baking sheet and sprinkle a small amount of salt over the top of each one._SEP_Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the crackers are golden brown and crispy._SEP_Remove from the oven and let cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely._SEP_Store in an airtight container for up to 1 week._SEP_Enjoy!

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Chicken-and-Oyster Mushroom Crepes Ingredients: Crepes: 3/4 cup all-purpose flour 1/8 teaspoon salt 1 cup fat-free milk 1 large egg 1 large egg white Cooking spray Filling: 1 tablespoon butter or stick margarine 1/2 cup sliced shallots 4 cups diced oyster mushroom caps (about 9 ounces) 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme 3 garlic cloves, chopped 3 tablespoons all-purpose flour 1 1/2 cups fat-free, less-sodium chicken broth 2 tablespoons dry sherry 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon black pepper 2 cups shredded ready-to-eat roasted skinned, boned chicken breasts (about 2 breasts) 1/4 cup (1 ounce) grated Asiago cheese._SEP_To prepare the crepes, lightly spoon 3/4 cup flour into dry measuring cups, and level with a knife._SEP_Combine flour and 1/8 teaspoon salt in a bowl._SEP_Add the milk, egg, and egg white, stirring with a whisk until almost smooth._SEP_Cover batter; chill 1 hour.Place an 8-inch crepe pan or nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat until hot.
gen_body: Remove from heat._SEP_Pour a scant 1/4 cup batter into pan; quickly tilt pan in all directions so batter covers pan with a thin film._SEP_Cook about 1 minute._SEP_Carefully lift edge of crepe with a spatula to test for doneness._SEP_The crepe is ready to turn when it can be shaken loose from the pan and the underside is lightly browned._SEP_Turn crepe over, and cook for 30 seconds or until center is set._SEP_Remove crepe from pan; place on a towel._SEP_Repeat procedure with remaining batter, stirring batter with a whisk before adding additional batter to pan._SEP_Stack crepes between single layers of wax paper or paper towels to prevent sticking._SEP_To prepare filling, melt butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat._SEP_Add shallots; cook 3 minutes or until tender, stirring frequently._SEP_Increase heat to medium-high._SEP_Add mushrooms; saut for 5 minutes or until tender, stirring occasionally._SEP_Stir in thyme and garlic, and saut for 1 minute._SEP_Sprinkle flour over mushroom mixture; cook 1 minute, stirring frequently._SEP_Gradually add chicken broth and sherry, stirring constantly with a whisk until blended._SEP_Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes or until mixture thickens._SEP_Stir in 1/4 teaspoon salt, black pepper, and chicken; cook for 2 minutes or until mixture is heated through._SEP_Warm crepes in microwave, if desired._SEP_To assemble crepes, spoon about 1/4 cup chicken mixture down center of each crepe._SEP_Roll up crepes; place seam side down on a baking sheet._SEP_Top each crepe with 1 1/2 teaspoons cheese._SEP_Broil 3 minutes or until cheese melts.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Summer Bagna Cauda Ingredients: Whole milk, for soaking 2 ounces anchovy fillets 1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil 6 young garlic cloves (or regular garlic), finely chopped 1/4 cup (1/2 stick) unsalted butter, cut into small pieces 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice Sea salt flakes and freshly ground pepper 4 pounds fresh vegetables, such as celery, Belgian endive, young wild fennel (halved lengthwise), Persian cucumbers (halved or quartered lengthwise), purple scallions, and Romano beans Calimyrna figs, for serving._SEP_Put milk into a shallow dish._SEP_Add anchovy fillets; soak 10 minutes._SEP_Drain on paper towels; pat dry._SEP_Coarsely chop._SEP_Put 1/4 cup oil and the garlic into a small saucepan over low heat.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Pao De Lo (Sponge Cake) Ingredients: 1 oranges, zest of or 1 lemon, zest of 2 large eggs, at room temperature 18 teaspoon salt 13 cup sugar 4 large eggs, at room temperature 13 cup unsifted all-purpose flour._SEP_1._SEP_Heat oven to 375 degrees F. prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Mazamorra Morada Ingredients: 1 lb dried purple corn 12 pineapple (including rind) 1 quinces (if available) 2 -3 cinnamon sticks 1 teaspoon whole cloves 1 apple 1 cup dried fruit (prunes, apricots, and or or cherries) 1 cup sugar 3 tablespoons cornstarch 1 lime, juice of._SEP_Place the dried fruit in a heat proof bowl and cover with boiling water._SEP_Set aside to cool._SEP_Add the purple corn to a large pot and cover with 10 cups of water._SEP_Chop the pineapple into small bite-size pieces and reserve.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Bakla-Squares and Ice Cream Ingredients: 3 (13 by 17-inch) sheets phyllo dough 4 tablespoons melted butter 1 cup sugar 2 tablespoons cinnamon 1/2 cup finely chopped walnuts 1 pint vanilla bean ice cream Honey, for garnish._SEP_Preheat oven to 400 degrees F._SEP_Spread a cookie sheet with parchment paper._SEP_Top with a layer of phyllo and brush or using a spritz bottle, spray with butter._SEP_Combine sugar and cinnamon and cover the sheet of pastry 1/3 cup sugar._SEP_Repeat with 2 more layers of pastry, then top with the finely chopped walnuts._SEP_Cut pastry into 3-inch squares with sharp paring knife.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Almond Fried Chicken With Spiced Ginger Sauce Recipe Ingredients: 4 1/2 lb chicken pcs 1/3 c. grated Parmesan Cheese 1/3 c. dry bread breadcrumbs 1/4 c. grnd almonds salt and pepper to taste 2 x Large eggs 1 Tbsp. lowfat milk 1/3 c. all purpose flour oil, for frying 1 Tbsp. finely grated fresh ginger 1 tsp whole allspice 1 tsp whole peppercorns 1/2 tsp mustard seed 1/2 tsp whole cloves 2/3 c. dry white wine 1/4 c. white wine vinegar 3 tsp soy sauce._SEP_Remove skin from chicken pcs._SEP_Pat dry with paper towels._SEP_Combine, cheese, breadcrumbs, almonds, salt and pepper._SEP_Set aside._SEP_Blend together Large eggs and lowfat milk._SEP_Dip chicken pcs in flour then egg mix then almond mix._SEP_Heat oil in frying pan.

prompt_body: HOW TO MAKE: Breakfast Nachos Recipe Ingredients: 1 (15-ounce) can pinto beans 1/4 cup water 3/4 teaspoon chili powder Kosher salt 4 large eggs 2 teaspoons Mexican-style hot sauce, such as Cholula or Tapatio Freshly ground black pepper 1 tablespoon unsalted butter 1 cup grated Monterey Jack cheese (about 4 ounces) 3 ounces tortilla chips (about 2 big handfuls) 1/3 cup salsa Guacamole, for serving (optional) Sour cream, for serving (optional)._SEP_Drain and rinse the beans._SEP_Place them in a small saucepan over medium heat._SEP_Add the water and chili powder and season with salt._SEP_Stir to combine and smash about half of the beans with the back of a fork or a wooden spoon._SEP_Cook, stirring occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes._SEP_Turn off the heat._SEP_Meanwhile, place the eggs in a medium bowl and beat with a fork until broken up._SEP_Add the hot sauce, season with a pinch each of salt and pepper, and beat to incorporate; set aside.
